title: 第六章　宪法的世界

zh: 《欧洲经济共同体条约》的历史意义在于，它使法律和政治机构的国际性与经济关系的国际性联系起来。在这个意义上，《欧洲经济共同体条约》体现为一部经济宪法。
en: The historical import of the European Economic Community treaty consists in its relating the internationality of law and political institutions to the internationality of economic relations. In this sense, the EEC treaty embodies an economic constitution.

zh: ——恩斯特-约阿希姆·梅斯特马克，1973年
en: —Ernst-Joachim Mestmäcker, 1973

zh: 欧洲是新自由主义世纪的一道谜题。有学者声称，欧洲经济共同体（EEC）从一开始就是一个新自由主义规划——当联邦德国、法国、意大利和比荷卢诸国于1957年3月议定《罗马条约》时，他们实际上是签下了哈耶克在1930年代拟定的联邦制蓝图。
另一些人则反驳说，哈耶克本人1945年之后恰恰反对欧洲联邦。
如果说欧洲经济共同体真是一场新自由主义的“胜利”，那该如何理解一位观察者在1962年所说的那句话——“持所谓新自由主义立场的经济学家长期以来一直在批评建立欧洲经济共同体的努力”？
欧洲一体化，究竟是因为有一套针对欧洲大陆的新自由主义愿景才发生，还是尽管有这一愿景仍然发生了？
en: Europe is one of the riddles of the neoliberal century. Some scholars claim that the European Economic Community (EEC) was a neoliberal project from the start—that when West Germany, France, Italy, and the Benelux countries agreed to the Treaty of Rome in March 1957, they were actually signing Hayek’s blueprints for federation from the 1930s.
Others counter with the point that Hayek himself was opposed to European federation after 1945.

If the EEC was a neoliberal “triumph,” what to make of an observer’s remark in 1962 that “economists of the so-called neoliberal persuasion have long criticized the efforts to establish a European Economic Community”?
Did European integration happen because of or in spite of a neoliberal vision for the continent?

zh: 要解开这一悖论，既要拉近镜头，也要拉远镜头。细看欧洲制度创设的那个时刻，我们会发现《罗马条约》把新自由主义阵营分成了两个派别。一边是年长一代的日内瓦学派新自由主义者，他们被贴上了普遍主义者（universalists）的标签。

另一边是较年轻的一批新自由主义者，我们可称之为宪政主义者。把镜头拉远，我们便能看到帝国与世界在这一故事中的分量。威廉·勒普克（Röpke）、戈特弗里德·哈伯勒、迈克尔·海尔佩林这些反对欧洲经济共同体的普遍主义者，体现的是对一项更早承诺的忠诚，即忠于由国际联盟、随后由关税与贸易总协定（General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade，GATT）所捍卫的更大尺度的全球整合。尤其令人恼火的是这样一个事实：《罗马条约》实际创造的不是“欧洲”，而是一个“欧非”（Eurafrica）版本。由于进入欧洲市场的优惠待遇被延伸给了作为“联系国”的法国、荷兰和比利时各帝国所属领地，共同市场百分之九十的领土面积落在欧洲本身的边界之外。
在普遍主义者看来，欧非不过是以整合之名瓦解世界经济的又一种手段。欧洲经济共同体在商品自由流通的网络中制造了一处血栓，其大小相当于西欧再加上非洲更大的一片。它在本应属于自由主义世界经济的时代里，让帝国和保护主义继续存活。
en: Resolving the paradox requires zooming both in and out. Looking closely at the moment of Europe’s institutional creation, we find that the Rome treaty split the neoliberal group into two factions. On one side was the older generation of Geneva School neoliberals, who have been labeled the universalists.

On the other side was another, younger cohort of neoliberals that we can call the constitutionalists. By drawing the lens back, we see the importance of empire and the world in the story. The universalists opposed to the EEC, like Wilhelm Röpke, Gottfried Haberler, and Michael Heilperin, reflected a fidelity to a prior commitment to the larger scale of global integration as defended by the League of Nations and later the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT). Especially galling was the fact that the Treaty of Rome actually created, not “Europe,” but a version of “Eurafrica.” Because preferential access to the European market was extended to the French, Dutch, and Belgian empires as “associated states,” 90 percent of the territorial area of the Common Market was beyond the borders of Europe itself.

To the universalists, Eurafrica looked like another means of disintegrating the world economy in the name of integration. The EEC created a clot the size of Western Europe plus larger parts of Africa in the network of free circulation of goods. It kept empire and protectionism alive in the supposed era of the liberal world economy.

zh: 普遍主义者确实做出了具体努力，以支撑关贸总协定、抵御欧洲经济共同体。1958年，哈伯勒与人合著了一份提交关贸总协定的报告，批评欧洲经济共同体正在成形的农业保护主义以及美国的农业补贴。这份所谓的《哈伯勒报告》成为关贸总协定、以及后来的世界贸易组织（世贸组织）历史上的一座里程碑，也让他意外地在全球南方找到了伙伴。然而，尽管普遍主义者热情高涨，他们的全球主义却含有一个致命缺陷：它没有执行机制。削弱经济民族主义的目标是明显的，但跃向超国家治理这一步却并不那么明显。把希望系于关贸总协定，第一代全球新自由主义者其实是把自己的信念寄托在一个没有牙齿的组织上。
en: Universalists made concrete efforts to shore up the GATT against the EEC. In 1958 Haberler coauthored a report for GATT criticizing the emerging agricultural protectionism of the EEC and agricultural subsidies in the United States. The so-called Haberler Report became a milestone in the history of GATT, and later the World Trade Organization (WTO), and won him unexpected partners in the Global South. Yet despite the universalists’ zeal, their globalism contained a fatal flaw: it had no mechanism of enforcement. The goal of diminishing economic nationalism was evident, but the leap to supranational governance was less so. By pinning their hopes on the GATT, the first-generation global neoliberals put their faith in an organization without teeth.

zh: 当一派新自由主义全球主义者否定欧洲一体化的价值时，另一支却把它看作横跨制度设计与制度落实之间那道鸿沟的桥梁。1960年代，汉斯·冯·德·格罗本（Hans von der Groeben）、恩斯特-约阿希姆·梅斯特马克和埃里希·霍普曼（Erich Hoppmann）等关键的新自由主义者把《罗马条约》构想为一部“经济宪法”，并视其为未来多层级治理模式的基础。

法律对于支持欧洲的新自由主义者至关重要，他们中许多人受的是法律训练而非经济学训练。尽管哈耶克关于联邦制的讨论在其战后著述中几乎消散殆尽，宪政主义者却改造了他1960年代关于宪政设计的文字，用以重新想象超国家秩序。颇具讽刺意味的是，日内瓦学派新自由主义那个定义战后时代的规划，恰恰萌发于老一代新自由主义者所谴责的欧洲一体化规划内部。通过把经济宪法的尺度从民族国家移向超国家联邦、再移向世界，新自由主义宪政主义者为随后在1970年代兴起的国际经济法领域播下了种子，并帮助把一个联合起来的欧洲理论化为全球经济治理的样板。
en: While one faction of neoliberal globalists rejected the value of European integration, another saw it as a bridge over the gap between institutional design and implementation. In the 1960s key neoliberals including Hans von der Groeben, Ernst-Joachim Mestmäcker, and Erich Hoppmann conceived of the Treaty of Rome as an “economic constitution” and the basis for future models of multilevel governance.

Law was central to pro-Europe neoliberals, many of whom were trained as lawyers rather than economists. Even though Hayek’s discussion of federation almost evaporated in his postwar work, the constitutionalists adapted his 1960s writings on constitutional design to reimagine supranational order. In an irony, the defining postwar project of Geneva School neoliberalism germinated inside the very project of European integration that the older neoliberals condemned. In shifting the scale of the economic constitution from the nation to the supranational federation and later the world, the neoliberal constitutionalists seeded the field of international economic law that would emerge in the 1970s and helped theorize an integrated Europe as a model for global economic governance.

zh: 普遍主义者：反对欧洲的新自由主义者
第二次世界大战于1945年结束后不久，新自由主义者就回到他们战前关于国际联邦的讨论。1947年朝圣山学社（Mont Pèlerin Society，MPS）的第一次会议，整整一天都用于讨论“欧洲联邦的问题与机会”。莱昂内尔·罗宾斯以他的忧虑定下基调：欧洲的“经济联合也许会破坏西方世界的统一”。
人们会记得，1930年代几乎所有的联邦设想都以英美关系为锚，把它当作西方世界的轴心。新自由主义知识分子们表示担心，欧洲的组织可能危及大西洋共同体的纽带。
基本问题在于各国不肯放弃自身主权，这一点显而易见。哈伯勒1949年撰文认为，“现在或者在我们这个时代都不会有欧洲联盟”，因为“像英国、法国、意大利和比利时这样的国家能够就共同经济政策达成一致，实际上是不可能的”。
他设想过在“国家对经济事务的干预较少，如同1914年以前的情形”这种条件下实现经济统一的可能性，但看不到任何可行的实现途径。联合国体系断然是国家之间（
-national）的，而不是超国家的，而被悉心看守的国家主权原则正是它的内核。
en: Immediately after 1945, neoliberals returned to their prewar discussions about

national federation. At the first meeting of the Mont Pèlerin Society (MPS), in 1947, an entire day was devoted to “the problem and chances of European Federation.” Robbins set the tone with his concern that European “economic associations might prove disruptive to the unity of the Western world.”

Almost all of the federal ideas of the 1930s, one will recall, were based on the anchor of the Anglo-American relationship as the axial point of the Western world. Neoliberal intellectuals voiced fears that European organization might endanger the bonds of the Atlantic Community.

The basic problem was the patent unwillingness of nations to relinquish their own sovereignty. Writing in 1949, Haberler argued that “there will be no European union now or in our time” because it was “practically impossible that countries like Great Britain, France, Italy and Belgium should agree on a common economic policy.”
He spoke hypothetically of the possibility of economic unification in a situation of “comparatively little state
ference in economic matters as it existed before 1914,” but saw no practical means of realization. The United Nations system was emphatically
national rather than supranational, and the jealously guarded principle of national sovereignty was at its heart.

zh: 针对欧洲一体化这一大陆梦想，普遍主义者坚持忠于国际联盟的全球愿景——国联曾为世界设想过一套门户开放（Open Door）政策。尽管到战争结束时国联内部的共识已转向充分就业与凯恩斯式扩张，在日内瓦学派新自由主义者的心中，国联仍保有良性自由国际主义的那份许诺。

然而，命运攸关之处在于：国联成功的先决条件从来都是有关各国的善意与自愿合作。既然没有惩罚成员国违规的手段，也没有迫使非成员国加入的手段，这一自由主义实验便在1930年代失败了，而1945年之后它似乎又注定重蹈覆辙。许多在1920年代和1930年代形成世界观的新自由主义者都与哈伯勒同样感到幻灭——那种大规模解决方案要求各国自愿交出主权，而这些国家并不想交出。尤其是看到所谓自由企业的灯塔美国自己竟要求各国制定多年期规划、以持续分配马歇尔计划资金这一“自相矛盾的现象”，哈伯勒看不到任何能把战后欧洲国家引离计划道路的路径。
尽管1949年成立的联邦德国开启的市场自由化提供了一个值得称道的样板，却不存在一种制度安排能让其他国家被迫追随德国的示范。正如我们在第4章所见，对新自由主义的解方来说，最好的选项看上去是投资法典与双边投资条约所构成的跨国商事法。专注于国际私法，就能在无需国际公法层面多边国家间安排的情况下，保护我所称的投资者之“异邦人权”（xenos rights）。
en: Against the continental dream of European integration the universalists maintained fidelity to the global vision of the League of Nations, which had envisioned an Open Door policy for the world. Even though by the end of the war the consensus at the League had shifted toward policies of full employment and Keynesian expansion, the League retained the promise of salutary liberal internationalism in the minds of Geneva School neoliberals.

Fatefully, however, the precondition for the League’s success was always the goodwill and voluntary cooperation of the states involved. With no means to punish infractions by member states, and no means of compelling nonmembers to join, the liberal experiment had failed in the 1930s and its seemed doomed again after 1945. Many neoliberals who had been socialized in the 1920s and 1930s shared Haberler’s sense of disillusionment with the large-scale solution that would involve the willing surrender of sovereignty by nations that had no desire to surrender it. Especially in light of the “paradoxical phenomenon” whereby the supposed beacon of free enterprise, the United States, was itself calling for nations to make multiyear plans to consistently disperse Marshall Plan funds, Haberler saw no route that could lead the postwar European states away from planning.

Although the beginnings of market liberalization in West Germany, founded in 1949, offered a praiseworthy template, there was no institutional fix whereby the other nations would be forced to follow the German lead. As we saw in Chapter 4, the best option for a neoliberal fix looked like the transnational commercial law of the investment code and the bilateral investment treaty. Concentrating on private international law would protect what I have called the xenos rights of investors without a need for multilateral inter-state arrangements of public international law.

zh: 1950年代嗓门最大的欧洲怀疑论者，是无处不在的威廉·勒普克——他的意见既能得到联邦德国经济部长（兼朝圣山学社成员）路德维希·艾哈德的倾听，又以公共知识分子的身份随时可得报刊版面。

勒普克担心，欧洲经济共同体会是1952年建立的欧洲煤钢共同体那种“集团方案”的延伸：以一道共同关税壁垒把欧洲大陆的产品保护起来，使之免于外国竞争，并由一个超国家官僚机构集体管理。在他看来，这种“集团”版本的欧洲没有资格被冠以“一体化”之名。它恰好复制了1930年代那种以保护主义和国家控制为特征的症状。看似欧洲的整合，将在世界尺度上延续分裂。这样的安排会“把民族国家的自给自足变成一个大陆的自给自足，并在更高的地理尺度上重演旧有的问题”。
en: The most vocal Euroskeptic of the 1950s was the ubiquitous Wilhelm Röpke, who enjoyed both the ear of West German economics minister (and MPS member) Ludwig Erhard and ready access to the press as a public intellectual.

Röpke feared that the EEC would be an extension of the “bloc solution” of the European Coal and Steel Community created in 1952, protecting the continent’s products behind a shared tariff wall, sheltered from foreign competition and managed collectively by a supranational bureaucracy. He felt that the “bloc” version of Europe had no claim to be labeled “integration.” It reproduced the precise symptoms of protectionism and state control that had characterized the 1930s. What looked like integration for Europe would perpetuate disintegration at the scale of the world. Such an arrangement would “turn national autarchy to a continental one and repeat the old problems at a higher geographical scale.”

zh: 迈克尔·海尔佩林表达了相近的情绪，并唤出了那个熟悉的吓人怪物——“隔绝”（insulation）。
集团化的欧洲，是去追求一个根本上不正当的政策目标的一种方式，那就是躲开全球竞争的压力。不仅如此，它还犯了哈耶克在1930年代描述过的那个致命错误：它使经济管理机构成为不满的靶子，人们把自己所感受到的不公归咎于这些机构。艾哈德认为，远为可取的是“一种秩序，它对各民族国家的行为施加一种不妨称为匿名的强制”。
与哈耶克和罗宾斯提出的新自由主义联邦模式一样，在艾哈德看来，政府干预的领域必须因锁定不移的自由贸易与自由迁移政策而自我设限。欧洲经济共同体所设想的由委员会（Commission）来领导，则会把自身变成受损各方不满与特殊请托的靶子。
en: Expressing a similar sentiment, Michael Heilperin conjured up the familiar bugbear “insulation.”

Bloc Europe was a way to pursue the fundamentally illegitimate policy goal of being sheltered from the pressures of global competition. Furthermore, it made the fatal error described by Hayek in the 1930s: it made economic authorities a target as the source of perceived injustices. Much preferable, Erhard argued, was “a system of order that exerted what one might call an anonymous coercion on the behavior of nation-states.”

As with the model of neoliberal federation proposed by Hayek and Robbins, the sphere of government intervention, on Erhard’s view, must be self-limiting due to locked-in policies of free trade and free migration. The EEC’s proposed leadership by a Commission would offer itself as a target for both the grievances and special pleading of affected parties.

zh: 普遍主义者把一体化定义为一种对旧秩序的回归，而非对未来的愿景。勒普克写道：“真理既根本又简单、无可辩驳：我们面前的任务实际上是一种再整合（re-
n），也就是重建一种过去已然存在、却自1931年以来在世界危机的风暴中被逐步摧毁的、更为幸福的欧洲经济关系状况。”
直到1914年都还是单一整体的世界经济，需要被重新建构起来。任何关于一体化的言说，只能是一种回归那逝去的黄金时代之手段的言说。普遍主义者的理解与这个词本身的词源是一致的。拉丁文
的含义不是创制一个新实体，而是恢复某个已经失去的东西。
1949年，海尔佩林提出了与勒普克相近的观点。他不认同“一体化”是随马歇尔计划输入欧洲的一种“美国学说”。事实上，它在欧洲比在传统上“偏爱关税”的美国更有根基。
当美国的政策制定者“敦促西欧一体化”时，他们其实是“把某样东西还给欧洲人——那不只是一种理论概念，它还应当能唤起他们对一段极为繁荣的往昔的记忆”。
en: Universalists defined
n not as a future vision but as a return to a former order. Wrote Röpke, “The truth [is] fundamental as it is simple and incontrovertible, that the task in front of us, is in fact, a
i.e., the recreation of a happier condition of European economic relations that already existed in the past and has been progressively destroyed in the storms of the world crisis since 1931.”
The world economy, which had been unitary until 1914, needed to be reconstituted. Any talk of
n could only be talk of a means of return to that lost golden age. The universalist understanding was consistent with the etymology of the word itself. The meaning of the Latin
is not the creation of a new entity but the restoration of something lost.
Heilperin made a point similar to Röpke’s in 1949. He disputed the fact that “
n” was an “American doctrine” imported into Europe with the Marshall Plan. In fact, it was much more at home in Europe than in the States, with its “traditional attachment to the tariff.”

When American policy makers urge “Western Europe to integrate,” they are “bringing back to the Europeans something which is not a theoretical concept alone but something which should spell to them a memory of a very prosperous past.”

zh: 大多数早期新自由主义者出生于二十世纪前后，大战之前的那段时期他们正处在童年后期与青春期早期。他们常以挽歌式的语言表达自己对那个时代的眷恋。勒普克在一本著作的开篇这样自认属于“那样一代人：他们在青春年少时见过西方世界那个漫长而光辉的晴日西沉时的霞光——那晴日从维也纳会议一直延续到1914年8月，而那些只活在历史的当下这片北极之夜中的人，对它绝不可能有充分的想象”。
世界经济一体化同时既是一个意识形态目标，也是一段童年牧歌。
en: Most early neoliberals were born around the turn of the twentieth century and were in late childhood and early adolescence during the period before the Great War. They often expressed their affective attachment to the era in elegiac terms. Röpke began one of his books by identifying himself as one of “the generation which in its youth saw the sunset glow of that long and glorious sunny day of the western world, which lasted from the Congress of Vienna until August 1914, and of which those who have only lived in the present arctic night of history can have no adequate conception.”
World economic integration was simultaneously an ideological goal and a childhood idyll.

zh: 在两次世界大战之间，新自由主义者对于把
（整合）这一概念引入经济话语居功至伟。弗里茨·马赫卢普（Fritz Machlup）已经表明，勒普克是1930年代最早系统论述一体化的经济学家之一。在埃利·赫克舍（Eli Heckscher）与贝蒂尔·俄林（Bertil Ohlin）——这两位斯德哥尔摩学派的瑞典经济学家——于1920年代和1930年代初把“解体”（dis
n）一词引入经济讨论之后，勒普克便开始着手撰写他1942年那本论述失去了什么、又需要恢复什么的著作。
1931年，他首次使用“解体”一词，用以描述大萧条的后果，即“那个以世界经济之名为期一个世纪之久而形成的、稳定而有机的国际经济关系结构的瓦解”。
他与米塞斯都在日内瓦高等国际问题研究院（Geneva Graduate Institute for International Studies）1938年一份专论“世界危机”的出版物中使用过这一术语。
en: Neoliberals had been central in bringing the concept of
into economic discourse in the interwar period. Fritz Machlup has shown that Röpke was one of the first economists to write systematically about
n in the 1930s. After Eli Heckscher and Bertil Ohlin, Swedish economists of the Stockholm School, introduced the word “dis
n” into economic discussions in the 1920s and early 1930s, Röpke began work on his 1942 book about what was lost and what needed to be restored.
He first used the term “dis

n” in 1931 to describe the effect of the Great Depression’s “dissolution of the stable and organic structure of international economic relations that had emerged over a century under the name of the world economy.”
He and Mises both used the term in a 1938 publication of the Geneva Graduate Institute for International Studies devoted to “the world crisis.”

zh: 日内瓦学派关于一体化的话语已在前几章中考察过。它把世界经济视为一个相互依存的整体，依靠一系列制度安排来维系资本主义那个双重世界中统治权（imperium）与所有权（dominium）之间的区分，并使竞争与国际分工同时得以成立。这一愿景与那种“市场自主或自我治理”的梦想相去甚远——后者曾被错误地安在新自由主义者头上。恰恰相反，它预设的是一个由普遍规范围封、靠国家间合作支撑的贸易与支付空间。新自由主义全球愿景在架构上的精巧与内在的一致性，使人很难设想部分解决方案，也很难设想通往世界层面再整合之路上的中间站。然而，正如海尔佩林所承认的，到1950年代，“普遍主义的解决方案”似乎已经失败了。
他放弃了推动自己起草的那部国际投资法典，转而接受业已变得更有效的双边投资条约的现实可行性。国际贸易组织（International Trade Organization）的丑闻——在他和其他新自由主义者看来，发展中国家为各自利益提出的政治诉求使它偏离了原定方向——最终留下的只有勒普克所称的“谦逊但极有用”的关贸总协定：一个相对软弱、布满例外条款（农业即在其内）与选择退出条款的组织。
en: The Geneva School discourse of integration has been explored in preceding chapters. It perceived the world economy as an interdependent totality reliant on a series of institutional arrangements that safeguarded the division in capitalism’s doubled world of imperium and dominium and allowed for both competition and the international division of labor. This vision was far different from the dream of an autonomous or self-governing market that has been falsely ascribed to neoliberals. Instead it assumed a space of trade and payments encased by universal norms and upheld by inter-state cooperation. The architectural elegance and internal consistency of the neoliberal global vision made it hard to think about partial solutions or halfway houses on the road to reintegration at the world level. Yet as Heilperin acknowledged, “universalist solutions” seemed to have failed by the 1950s.

He gave up on pushing the international investment code he had authored and accepted the viability of bilateral investment treaties, which had become more effective. The scandal of the International Trade Organization, which he and other neoliberals saw as tainted by the politicized special pleading of the developing world, left only what Röpke called the “modest but very useful” GATT, a relatively weak organization riddled with exceptions (including agriculture) and opt-out clauses.

zh: 怀疑欧洲的新自由主义者聚集在关贸总协定周围——尽管它看起来软弱——把它当作攻击新建的欧洲经济共同体的手头最佳武器。就其本质而言，关贸总协定是日内瓦首创的自由主义世界经济模式的制度继承者，而该模式本身又建立在十九世纪“最惠国”条约的原则之上；这一原则把贸易壁垒的对等放宽延伸给所有签署方。关贸总协定的主要设计者詹姆斯·米德（James Meade）早年在国联十分活跃，并在1930年代末执笔该机构的《世界经济调查》（
1958年，勒普克在法国主导的欧洲机构面前为关贸总协定张目，说“用煤钢共同市场的方法整合欧洲……需要一个超国家的政治秩序”。“为什么不交给关贸总协定？”他问道，“如果关贸总协定效力不足，为什么不加强它？”
艾哈德在倡导关贸总协定的优越性时，是以“经济”本身的名义发言的，他说：“对经济犯下的错误与罪过，不会因为宣称它们是欧洲的就得以免除。”
en: Euroskeptical neoliberals rallied around the GATT, despite its apparent weakness, as the best weapon at hand for attacking the new EEC. In its essence, GATT was the institutional heir of the liberal world economy model pioneered in Geneva, which was itself based on the nineteenth-century principle of the “most favored nation” treaty that extended reciprocal relaxation of trade barriers to all signees. GATT’s primary architect, James Meade, had been active at the League, authoring its
in the late 1930s.

Röpke advocated for the GATT against French-dominated European institutions in 1958, saying that the “Coal Steel common market method of integrating Europe … requires a supra-national political order.” “Why not leave it to GATT?” he asked, “Or if GATT is insufficiently effective, why not strengthen it?”
Erhard spoke in the name of “the economy” as such when he promoted the superiority of the GATT, saying that “errors and sins against the economy are not made good by proclaiming them to be European.”

zh: 在勒普克看来，唯一或许配得上一体化之名的形式，遵循的是他所谓的“内核方案”（kernel solution）。内核欧洲不会把自己的商品同外部世界隔开；相反，它会创建一个自由贸易区，并最终形成一个共同的“支付共同体”或货币联盟，随时间逐步扩展，把其他国家吸纳进一块不断增大的专业化与自由市场竞争的领地。这种一体化“可以始于欧洲”，但它“为过渡到普遍的世界经济一体化做准备”。
针对欧洲经济共同体，勒普克和艾哈德主张建立欧洲自由贸易联盟（European Free Trade Area，EFTA），成员包括大不列颠、瑞士、奥地利、葡萄牙和斯堪的纳维亚诸国。
欧洲自由贸易联盟模式未能压过欧洲经济共同体理念，这意味着——勒普克在《国家评论》（National Review）上写道——“经济的解放……不得不靠挖一道对抗外部世界的壕沟来换取”。
en: To Röpke, the only form of integration that might be worthy of the name followed what he called the “kernel solution.” Kernel Europe would not protect its goods from the outside world. Rather, it would create a free-trade zone and, eventually, a common “payment community” or currency union that would gradually expand over time, absorbing other nations into an ever-growing territory of specialization and free-market competition. This form of integration “may begin in Europe” but it “prepares for a transition into a universal world-economic integration.”
Against the EEC, Röpke and Erhard advocated for a European Free Trade Area (EFTA), to include Great Britain, Switzerland, Austria, Portugal, and the Scandinavian countries.
The failure of the EFTA model to win out over the EEC concept meant, Röpke wrote in the
that “economic liberation … had to be purchased by digging a moat against the outside.”

zh: 汉斯·冯·德·格罗本事后写道，“‘普遍主义者’把任何一种区域性架构都视为对正道的偏离”，
这番话只稍有夸张。他说，他们把围绕欧洲一体化的斗争描绘成善恶两极对立的样子，呼吁建立欧洲经济共同体的人被安排扮演反派。勒普克则动用他标志性的煽烈修辞，疾呼不要让“市场经济”被“牺牲在‘欧洲’的祭坛上”，并警告“原本被指望充当黏合剂的东西，也许会证明是炸药”。
海尔佩林搬出了十九世纪政治经济学那些奠基性的论战。“自由贸易与保护主义之争，在在思想和政治领域被束之高阁数十年，如今竟不可思议地重新登上了头版。”
面对如此非此即彼的选项，普遍主义者自然站在自由贸易一边；用海尔佩林援引古典自由主义教义的话说，自由贸易“符合事物的本性，也符合资源与人口在全球的分布”。
在经济部长艾哈德治下，联邦德国代表自由贸易的一极，而主要对手是法国。海尔佩林在《财富》（Fortune）杂志的一篇文章中，用一个政治上分量很重的词谴责法国所选的“隔离”（segregation），认为它伤害了“法国消费者的多数——他们在这个本质上富裕却可耻地受制肘的法国经济中是最大的输家”。
en: Hans von der Groeben exaggerated only slightly when he wrote in hindsight that “the ‘universalists’ saw every regional structure as a deviation from the path of righteousness.”

They painted the struggle over European integration in Manichaean terms, he said, with those calling for the EEC cast in the role of villains. Röpke relied on his characteristically incendiary rhetoric, urging that “the market economy” not be “sacrificed on the altar of ‘Europe’ ” and cautioning that “what was meant to be mortar may prove to be dynamite.”

Heilperin invoked the foundational modern battles of political economy from the nineteenth century. “Buried for many decades in intellectual and political mothballs,” he wrote, “the Free Trade versus Protection controversy has, incredibly, become once again a front-page item.”

Given such an alternative, universalists naturally sided with free trade, which, said Heilperin in the terms of classical liberal dogma, “conforms to the nature of things and to the distribution of resources and men on the globe.”
West Germany represented the pole of free trade, under Economics Minister Erhard, and the main antagonist was France. In an article in

Heilperin, using a politically loaded term, denounced the French choice of “segregation,” which harmed “the mass of French consumers, who are the big losers in France’s essentially rich, shamefully hobbled economy.”

zh: 核心新自由主义者阵营中第一个偏离反对欧洲经济一体化立场的，不是始终坚决反对的勒普克，而是艾哈德部里的一名官员——阿尔弗雷德·缪勒-阿尔马克（Alfred Müller-Armack）。缪勒-阿尔马克生于1901年，与第一代新自由主义者是同代人。自1933年起即为纳粹党成员，1940年起在明斯特大学主持一个经济学教席，负责有关住宅建筑、定居与纺织生产的研究。
他战时的部分研究处理的正是第三帝国版本的欧洲一体化，为纳粹在东欧的帝国寻求经济解决方案。
缪勒-阿尔马克在1940年代初结识艾哈德——这位未来的经济部长和总理当时也在希特勒政府下研究纺织工业。
两人战后依然亲近。与瓦尔特·欧肯和弗朗茨·伯姆的弗莱堡学派一道，他们帮助界定了德国新自由主义的基础立场。1950年，缪勒-阿尔马克成为科隆大学教授；1952年，他在艾哈德的经济部出任政策部门负责人。
en: The first member of the hard core of neoliberals to deviate from opposition to European economic integration was not Röpke, who remained a staunch opponent, but an employee of Erhard’s ministry, Alfred Müller-Armack. Born in 1901, Müller-Armack was a contemporary of the first generation of neoliberals. A member of the Nazi party since 1933, he held a chair in economics at the University of Münster from 1940, where he directed research on building, settlement, and textile production.
Some of his wartime studies tackled the Third Reich’s iteration of European integration in seeking economic solutions for the Nazi empire in Eastern Europe.
Müller-Armack met Erhard in the early 1940s, as the future economics minister and chancellor was also researching the textile industry under Hitler’s government.

The duo remained close after the war. Along with the Freiburg School of Walter Eucken and Franz Böhm, they helped define the foundational German neoliberal position. In 1950 Müller-Armack became a professor at the University of Cologne, and took a position as the leader of the policy department in Erhard’s Economics Ministry in 1952.

zh: 与勒普克和哈伯勒不同——他们的学术职位护住了他们的纯粹性——缪勒-阿尔马克在政治与行政中的活跃角色使他更清楚地意识到，必须寻找可实行的方案，并与意识形态上的对手找到共同点。
他的一项持久成就是创造了“社会市场经济”这个术语。该词把自由市场原则与对福利和劳工议题的关注结合在一起，随时间推移会让其他新自由主义者感到恼火；但缪勒-阿尔马克选择这个术语，正是看中了它调和性的、“息讼”（irenic）功能。
1957年论及欧洲一体化的前景时，缪勒-阿尔马克采取了类似的务实立场。他固然把1914年之前的世界经济一体化奉为“典范”，却指出条件已经改变，制度必须随之调适。关贸总协定提供了一种选项，但它的“组织上的迟钝”证明，“复杂且在组织上要求极高的协定只能在有限的圈子里获得成功”。
他认为，即便以“世界性组织”为取向，一体化也只能“在一个紧密的欧洲圈子的倡议下”发生。
en: Unlike Röpke and Haberler, whose academic perches protected their purism, Müller-Armack’s active role in politics and administration made him more aware of the need to find practicable solutions and common ground with ideological opponents.

One such accomplishment was his enduring achievement in coining the term “social market economy.” The term combined free-market principles with attention to welfare and labor concerns in a way that would rankle other neoliberals over time, but Müller-Armack had chosen the term precisely for its mediating “irenic” function.

Writing about the prospects of European integration in 1957, Müller-Armack took a similar pragmatic position. While genuflecting to the era before 1914 as a “paragon” of world economic integration, he pointed out that conditions had changed and institutions needed to adapt with them. The GATT offered one option, but its “organizational sluggishness” proved that “complicated and organizationally demanding agreements only offer success in limited circles.”
Even while oriented at “worldwide organizations,” he argued, integration would only happen “on the initiative of a tight European circle.”

zh: 到1957年，缪勒-阿尔马克已可从经验出发说话。1955年5月，他在自己的避暑别墅召集了一次各主管负责人会议，帮助把德国内阁内部对立的观点缝合了起来。
在那次会议上，艾哈德顺从了由总理康拉德·阿登纳（Konrad Adenauer）及其外交部主导的欧洲一体化项目。缪勒-阿尔马克与艾哈德还设法把这个愿景从煤钢共同体的模式推开，转向一个能够保护“不受扭曲的竞争”、并优先保障商品、资本、服务与劳动力自由流动这“四大自由”的方案。
竞争性共同市场的概念此前已在经济部中被构想出来，部分出自律师出身的冯·德·格罗本之手——自1952年起他便领导经济部内的舒曼计划处。
1955年6月六个签署国代表在墨西拿开会之后，比利时外交大臣保罗-亨利·斯巴克（Paul-Henri Spaak）委托冯·德·格罗本和皮埃尔·吕里（Pierre Uri）起草一份条约——即所谓的《斯巴克报告》——它成为自1956年春天开始的谈判的基础。
在谈判中，冯·德·格罗本出任共同市场委员会主席，缪勒-阿尔马克获任委员。
en: By 1957 Müller-Armack could speak from experience. He had helped suture together opposing viewpoints within the German cabinet when he held a meeting of the principals at his summer house in May 1955.

At that meeting Erhard acquiesced to the project of European integration being spearheaded by Chancellor Konrad Adenauer and his Foreign Ministry. Müller-Armack and Erhard also managed to push the vision away from the Coal and Steel Community model and toward one that could protect “undistorted competition” and prioritize the “four freedoms” of goods, capital, services, and labor.

The concept of the competitive common market had been crafted ahead of time in the Economics Ministry, in part by the lawyer von der Groeben, who had led the Schuman Plan Department in the Economics Ministry since 1952.

After a meeting of delegates of the six signatories in Messina in June 1955, the Belgian foreign minister, Paul-Henri Spaak, tasked von der Groeben and Pierre Uri to draft a treaty—the so-called Spaak Report—that became the basis of negotiation beginning in the spring of 1956.
Von der Groeben was made the chair of the committee on the Common Market in the negotiations and Müller-Armack was made a member.

zh: 经过在巴黎和布鲁塞尔为期一年的谈判，条约于1957年3月在罗马签署，孩子们列在道路两旁挥舞六个签署国的小国旗。罗马街头报亭上的海报画着六个穿着以各国国旗颜色点缀的罩衫的农家女围圈起舞——这预示了农业在随之而来的欧洲中的中心地位。
条约本身是数月谈判与妥协的产物。从一个角度看，它似乎是新自由主义者的一次胜利：四大自由与对不受扭曲之竞争的承诺一并被写进文本。
从另一个角度看，这份成功则要复杂得多。没有执行机制来落实规制垄断与卡特尔的竞争法则，条款本身也带有与法国谈判方作出重大妥协的痕迹。
当悬而未决的农业议题经由1962年通过的共同农业政策（Common Agricultural Policy，CAP）得到处理时，其中包含了明显非新自由主义的措施——“政治决定的价格，以及针对主要产品的浮动进口税与出口补贴”。
勒普克从不放轻拳头，他把共同农业政策称为“现代工业经济中所曾创造出来的最荒唐的价格核定、补贴与人为采购安排体系”。
共同农业政策的效应是“加剧了哈伯勒在1958年所指出的问题”。
《罗马条约》以及由它产生的欧洲经济共同体，是一件妥协的混合造物，远非某些学者所声称的那种明确无误的新自由主义“战胜……法国干预主义的残余”。
en: After a year of negotiations in Paris and Brussels, the treaty was signed in Rome in March 1957 as children lined the roads waving miniature flags of the six signatory nations. Posters on the kiosks along the Roman streets showed six farm girls dancing in circles in blouses decorated with the national colors, foreshadowing the centrality of agriculture in the Europe that would follow.

The treaty itself was a product of months of negotiation and compromise. Looked at from one angle, it appeared to be a neoliberal victory. The four freedoms were enshrined in the text alongside a commitment to undistorted competition.

From another angle, the success was more mixed. There were no mechanisms to enforce the laws of competition regulating monopolies and cartels, and the provisions themselves bore the marks of significant compromise with the French negotiators.

When the unresolved issues of agriculture were addressed through the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) passed in 1962, it included the markedly non-neoliberal measures of “politically determined prices as well as variable import levies and export subsidies for major products.”

Never one to soften a punch, Röpke referred to the CAP as “the most grotesque system of price-fixing, subsidies, and artificial purchasing arrangements that had ever been created in a modern industrial economy.”
The effect of the CAP was to “exacerbate the problems identified by Haberler” in 1958.

The Treaty of Rome, and the EEC that emerged from it, was a hybrid artifact of compromise and far from the clear-cut neoliberal “triumph … over remnants of French interventionism” that some scholars claim.

zh: 对新自由主义原则而言，最大的偏离之一正出在帝国问题上。《罗马条约》的第四部分专门处理了一个用委婉语命名的议题——“与比利时、法国、意大利和荷兰有特殊关系的非欧洲国家和地区”（第131条）。冯·德·格罗本和吕里在《斯巴克报告》中并未把殖民地问题写进去，但法国把纳入这一问题作为签署条约的条件。
结果，正如近期一项研究所言，共同市场构成了“一个从波罗的海延伸到刚果的领土范围”。
具体而言，条约保障了法兰西、比利时、荷兰和意大利诸帝国的十八个非洲殖民地的产品在一个初始五年期内免税进入市场，并授予了保护幼稚产业的权利（第133条）。由于共同市场将针对第三方生产者设置共同对外关税，这就意味着殖民地的热带产品相对于欧洲诸帝国之外的竞争者将享有显著优势——尤其是拉丁美洲的生产者，他们传统上与西欧、特别是与联邦德国保持着活跃的贸易。
en: One of the greatest deviations from neoliberal principles was on the question of empire. The fourth part of the Treaty of Rome was devoted to the euphemistically titled “non-European countries and territories which have special relations with Belgium, France, Italy and the Netherlands” (Article 131). Von der Groeben and Uri had not included the question of the colonies in the Spaak Report, but the French made their inclusion a condition of signing the Treaty.
As a result, the Common Market, as a recent study put it, constituted “a territorial sphere stretching from the Baltic to the Congo.”

Specifically, the treaty secured tariff-free access to the market for the products of the eighteen African colonies of the French, Belgian, Dutch, and Italian empires for an initial period of five years and also granted the right to infant industry protection (Article 133). Because the Common Market would have a common external tariff against third-party producers, this meant that the tropical products of the colonies would enjoy a significant advantage against competitors outside of the European empires, especially producers in Latin America, who traditionally enjoyed robust trade with Western Europe and especially West Germany.

zh: 帝国问题对缪勒-阿尔马克而言绝非一条脚注。他的回忆录中有整整一章献给了联系领地问题。他叙述说，法国和比利时的谈判代表在谈判的最后一天出其不意地提出，批准条约的条件是让海外领地成为联系国及领地，迫使各单项产品的关税谈判一直拖到深夜。在那场“动荡激烈的夜场会议……抵抗到最后一刻”上，缪勒-阿尔马克紧盯香蕉问题，反对向来自共同市场之外的香蕉课以百分之二十关税的提案——这项关税本身就是意大利保护其殖民地索马里香蕉种植的产物。据报道，阿登纳站在缪勒-阿尔马克一边，并因这一议题推迟谈判的收尾以示抗议。
即便在谈判技术上已经结束之后，缪勒-阿尔马克还是赢得了与罗贝尔·马尔约兰（Robert Marjolin）一同起草最后一份议定书的机会，该议定书作为附件被纳入最终文本。这份所谓的《香蕉议定书》在巴黎最后一轮谈判与罗马签署条约之间完成；它为联邦德国取得了可续期的免税进口权，使其可以从欧洲各帝国保护的非洲产地和法国在加勒比的海外领地之外进口香蕉，从而在共同市场的关税壁垒上打开了一道裂缝。
en: Empire was no footnote to Müller-Armack. He devoted an entire chapter of his memoirs to the matter of the associated territories. He recounted that the French and Belgian negotiators sprang association as a “surprise” condition for ratification on the final day of negotiations, which pushed the negotiation of tariffs for individual products late into the night. Müller-Armack zeroed in on the question of bananas at the “turbulent night session … offering resistance to the very last” to the proposal that bananas from outside of the Common Market be burdened with a 20 percent tariff—itself an artifact of the Italian protection of their colonial Somali banana crop. Adenauer reportedly sided with Müller-Armack, delaying the completion of the negotiations in protest over the issue.

Even after the negotiations technically were concluded, Müller-Armack won the chance to draft a last protocol with Robert Marjolin to be included as an annex in the final version. Completed between the final negotiations in Paris and the treaty’s signing in Rome, the so-called Banana Protocol created a crack in the tariff wall of the Common Market by securing renewable access for West Germany to duty-free bananas from beyond the protected African producers of the European empires and the French overseas territories in the Caribbean.

zh: 香蕉成了缪勒-阿尔马克的一场意识形态之战。“从外面看，整件事也许显得滑稽，”他写道，“但我们想要强调的是我们对这样一种经济政策的信念——它不对所有其他香蕉出口的发展中国家造成严重歧视。”
新自由主义者对这种划分经济集团的做法的忧虑，在殖民地贸易上最为充分地得到了印证。勒普克1958年指出，荒谬的是，“为了共同市场更大的荣耀”，从巴西、危地马拉和哥斯达黎加入口的咖啡与香蕉竟要因保护性关税而变得更贵。“我们不该责怪这些遭受如此歧视的国家，”他写道，“为了自保而向关贸总协定申诉。”
缪勒-阿尔马克本人也主张，被排除在外的国家完全有权利就《罗马条约》的条件向关贸总协定申诉。
普遍主义者抓住农业与欧非不放，在关贸总协定阵地上攻击欧洲一体化。香蕉、咖啡与可可的问题毫不琐碎，它为日内瓦学派新自由主义者开启了数十年的斗争——反对他们在自由主义世界贸易体系中所看到的帝国之延续。二十一世纪初那场著名的“香蕉战争”，起点正是围绕《罗马条约》的一场争斗。
问题始终是同一个：帝国究竟已被自由主义世界经济所取代，还是殖民历史仍应塑造全球经济关系？
en: Bananas became an ideological battle for Müller-Armack. “The whole thing might seem funny from the outside,” he wrote, “but we wanted to emphasize our conviction in an economic policy that did not enact serious discrimination against all other banana-exporting developing countries.”

Neoliberal fears of bloc thinking seemed most realized in the colonies. Röpke observed in 1958 that it was absurd that, “to the greater glory of the Common Market,” coffee and bananas entering from Brazil, Guatemala, and Costa Rica should be made more expensive by protective tariffs. “One cannot blame such countries treated with such discrimination,” he wrote, “for seeking to protect themselves by appeals to GATT.”
Müller-Armack himself argued that excluded nations had every right to appeal to the GATT against the conditions of the Rome treaty.

The universalists fastened onto agriculture and Eurafrica to attack European integration at the GATT. Far from trivial, the question of bananas, coffee, and cocoa opened decades of struggle for Geneva School neoliberals against what they saw as the persistence of empire in the liberal world trading system. The famous “banana wars” of the early twenty-first century began with a fight over the Treaty of Rome.
The issue was the same: Had empire been displaced by the liberal world economy, or should colonial history still shape global economic relations?

zh: 关贸总协定对阵欧非：1958年的《哈伯勒报告》

children: GATT VERSUS EURAFRICA: THE 1958 HABERLER REPORT

zh: 欧洲创设过程中的欧洲之外背景常常被忽略。
按照冯·德·格罗本自己的说法，法国深陷阿尔及利亚的反殖民冲突，这使它更倾向于顺从联邦德国的压力，从更以国家为中心的计划化（planification）路径上偏离出去。
阿登纳在1956年苏伊士危机期间坚定支持法国和英国这两个老牌帝国主义国家的军事干预，这也为他赢得了法国人的好感。
缪勒-阿尔马克把苏伊士干预视为“政治上的疯狂”，但他仍然承认：在欧洲共同对美国的地缘政治力量心存戒备之时，法德的和解帮助谈判度过了一个关键阶段。
一位法国观察者后来调侃说，应当为埃及领导人加麦尔·阿卜杜勒·纳塞尔（Gamal Abdel Nasser）立一座雕像，称他为“欧洲的联合者”——正是他把运河国有化，为西欧最大的几个强国彼此结好创造了条件。
en: The extra-European context for the creation of Europe is often overlooked.

By von der Groeben’s own account, France’s embroilment in anticolonial conflict in Algeria predisposed it to be more acquiescent to West German pressure to diverge from more state-centered approaches of
Adenauer’s staunch support for the military intervention of the old imperial powers of France and Britain during the Suez Crisis of 1956 also won him favor with the French.

Müller-Armack, who saw the Suez intervention as “political insanity,” nonetheless acknowledged that the moment of French-German rapprochement in a shared moment of European defensiveness against U.S. geopolitical power helped move negotiations through a critical phase.

A French observer quipped later that a statue should be raised to Egyptian leader Gamal Abdel Nasser as the “federator of Europe” for nationalizing the canal and creating the conditions for the largest Western European powers to bond.

zh: 对勒普克来说，苏伊士危机提供了一个反思旧世界与新世界之差异的机会。他指出，十九世纪的苏伊士运河并不是“一个悬而未决的世界经济问题”。它的稳定由一项国际法条约保障，而该条约以“文明世界的信念与原则……为支撑，并受到大不列颠霸权的保护”。在帝国主义国家无可争议的“受托者”地位被削弱之后，国际组织只是不完美的替代品。“若组建一个国际苏伊士运河管理局，那倒是符合国际秩序的新原则，”他讥讽地写道，“可这怎么可能实现？谁来抵挡刚刚喷发的民族主义那火山般的力量？”
美国是一个不可靠的伙伴。勒普克批评它在苏伊士危机期间“投入了一个全然不负责任的东方专制者的怀抱”。
尽管如第5章结论部分所指出的，勒普克在1930年代就把自己的自由主义与反帝国主义结合在一起，但在一个多边主义与权威弥散的时代，他流露出对帝国的怀旧。
en: For Röpke, the Suez Crisis offered a chance to reflect on the difference between the old world and the new. The Suez Canal had not been “an unresolved problem of the world economy” in the nineteenth century, he observed. Its stability was ensured by a treaty in international law underwritten by the “convictions and principles of the civilized world … protected by the supremacy of Great Britain.” International organizations were only imperfect substitutes after the undisputed “trustee” position of imperial powers had been undermined. “It would correspond to the new principles of international order,” he wrote wryly, “if an International Suez Canal Authority were to be constituted. But how is this supposed to happen? Who will oppose the volcanic force of freshly erupting nationalism?”
The United States was an unreliable partner. Röpke criticized it for having “fallen into the arms of a completely irresponsible oriental despot” during the Suez Crisis.

Although, as noted in the conclusion of Chapter 5, Röpke had combined his liberalism with anti-imperialism in the 1930s, he betrayed nostalgia for empire in an era of multilateralism and diffused authority.

zh: 勒普克那哀怨的语调，透露出普遍主义者在1950年代末期所感到的无力。他们被夹在中间：大西洋一边是他们眼中的保护主义式欧洲一体化，另一边是世界经济秩序那个不可靠的守护者，而联合国则不断涌入南方国家——这些国家正用它们对本国资源的主权要求和对全球再分配的要求，打破十九世纪的规则。正如我们在第4章所见，新自由主义者把苏伊士危机与其他国有化事件解读为一个征兆，即政府之统治权（imperium）与私有财产之所有权（dominium）这一至关重要的区分正在丧失。哪些制度能够替代帝国而值得新自由主义者效忠，这一点并不清楚。就欧洲而言，戈特弗里德·哈伯勒借关贸总协定作出了最有组织的抵制。
en: Röpke’s plaintive tone suggests the impotence felt by universalists in the late 1950s. They were flanked by what they saw as protectionist European integration on one side of the Atlantic, an untrustworthy guardian of the world economic order on the other, and a UN steadily filling with Southern nations that were breaking the rules of the nineteenth century with their demands for sovereignty over national resources and global redistribution. As we saw in Chapter 4, neoliberals interpreted the Suez Crisis and other nationalizations as signs of a loss of the all-important division between the imperium of government and the dominium of private ownership. It was not clear to neoliberals which institutional replacements for empire were worthy of their loyalty. In the case of Europe, the most concerted stand was taken by Gottfried Haberler through the organization of the GATT.

zh: 正如缪勒-阿尔马克一例中已经提示的，非洲国家与欧洲经济共同体的联系是新自由主义批判的一个特别靶子。它让共同体各国共同维持法国的殖民安排，并分担相关义务：一方面延伸农产品的优惠准入，另一方面共同出资设立一个欧洲发展基金。在艾哈德看来，对欧非的承诺无非是“把帝国的成本欧洲化”，并有再造保护主义集团之虞——这对联邦德国几乎没有用处，因为它从殖民地的西非和中非只采购其进口中的一小部分。
在被迫接受在六个条约签署国的边境重筑农业关税壁垒之后，新自由主义者如今又不得不咽下把这些壁垒向南延伸、越过地中海一直伸入非洲腹地的苦果。
en: As already suggested in the case of Müller-Armack, the association of the African states with the EEC was a special target of neoliberal critique. It collectivized the features and obligations of French colonialism by extending preferential access for agricultural imports and by co-financing a European Development Fund. To Erhard, the commitment to Eurafrica simply “Europeanized the costs of empire” and threatened to recreate protectionist blocs that were of little use to West Germany, which purchased only a fraction of its imports from colonial West and Central Africa.

After being forced to accept the reconstruction of agricultural tariff walls around the borders of the six nations signatory to the treaty, neoliberals now had to swallow the extension of those walls southward to the other side of the Mediterranean and far into Africa.

zh: 欧非（
）这一概念今天鲜为人知，但在1960年代正式的非殖民化席卷非洲之前的年月里曾广为流传。对不同人群，它有不同的含义。在法国，欧非的愿景关乎保存并深化帝国，但也或许关乎改造帝国。塞内加尔议员莱奥波尔德·塞达尔·桑戈尔（Léopold Senghor）与国民议会“海外独立派”（Indépendants d’Outre Mer）党团中其他议员一道支持欧非。
对他们来说，这似乎是一种办法：即便他们“横向”地与其他非洲人建立联系，仍能“纵向”地保留一条向法国提出应得权益之要求的路径。
桑戈尔还觉得，它可能是一条在新的“文化互惠”精神之下把社会民主扩展到非洲的道路。
在欧洲经济共同体谈判期间，科特迪瓦领导人费利克斯·乌弗埃-博瓦尼（Félix Houphouët-Boigny）来到布鲁塞尔，恳请各国代表批准非洲殖民地的联系安排。按照缪勒-阿尔马克的回忆，很大程度上正是他那番富有说服力的辩护之力，帮助把对法属殖民地的财政援助写入《罗马条约》并获得通过。
en: Although little known today, the concept of Eurafrica circulated widely in the years before formal decolonization swept across Africa in the 1960s. It had different meanings for different populations. In France, visions of
were about retaining and deepening, but also perhaps transforming, empire. Senegalese deputy Léopold Senghor supported
along with other delegates from deputies in the Indépendents d’Outre Mer bloc in the National Assembly.
For them it seemed a way to retain a means for voicing demands as entitlements from France “vertically” even as they created connections to other Africans “horizontally.”
Senghor also felt it could be a route to extending social democracy to Africa in a new spirit of “cultural reciprocity.”

During the EEC negotiations, Ivory Coast leader Félix Houphouët-Boigny came to Brussels to appeal to the national delegates to approve association for the African colonies. In Müller-Armack’s recollection, it was largely the power of his persuasive defense that helped secure approval for financial aid to the French colonies as part of the Treaty of Rome.

zh: 相形之下，法国总理居伊·摩勒（Guy Mollet）对欧非的看法是家长式的。1957年他说：“整个欧洲都将被召唤来帮助非洲的发展。”
摩勒的表述让人想起泛欧运动的鼻祖理查德·库登霍夫-卡莱基（Richard Coudenhove-Kalergi）的说法——1929年正是他造出了“
”一词，主张以在非洲开辟可耕地、治愈疾病这一共同事业把欧洲诸强联合起来。
欧非的这一面向更清晰地回响着1884—1885年柏林会议的情绪：当时欧洲殖民列强在压制奴隶制、把自由贸易带入非洲的共同事业中表达了它们的团结——用卡尔·施米特的话说，那是“欧洲列强对非欧洲土地最后一次共同的抢占”。
en: French prime minister Guy Mollet’s perspective on
by contrast, was paternalistic. In 1957 he said that “all of Europe will be called upon to help in the development of Africa.”
Mollet’s formulation recalled that of the father of the Pan-European Movement, Richard Coudenhove-Kalergi, who had coined the term “
” in 1929, proposing that the common project of creating arable land and curing disease in Africa would bring European powers together.
This angle on

more clearly echoed the sentiment of the Berlin Conference of 1884–1885 when the European colonies expressed their unity in the common project of suppressing slavery and bringing free trade to Africa, in what Carl Schmitt calls the “last common land-appropriation of non-European soil by the European powers.”

zh: 按这种意义理解，欧非实际上加剧了两个大陆之间的差距，尽管它把二者合并在一个词里。这一规划落地为现实的过程，显示了权力平衡中持续的不对称。尽管桑戈尔提出“欧非不能在没有非洲人同意的情况下被创造出来”，乌弗埃-博瓦尼的在场恰恰是印证规则的那条例外。1957年《罗马条约》的谈判以及法国国民议会就该条约展开的辩论，除此之外都是在没有非洲代表出席或参与的情况下进行的。
en: Understood in this sense, Eurafrica actually exaggerated the gap between the two continents even as it combined them in a single term. The process of the project’s realization suggested the continuing asymmetry in the balance of power. Despite Senghor’s demand that “

cannot be created without the consent of Africans,” the presence of Houphoët-Boigny was the exception that proved the rule. The Treaty of Rome negotiations and debate in the French National Assembly about the treaty in 1957 happened otherwise without the presence or participation of African delegates.

zh: 对德国人而言，欧非（
）与纳粹时代的地缘政治思想及其把经济空间视为按领土争夺的零和格局的观念纠缠在一起。
在联邦德国，
通常被视为法国人维系其殖民帝国的一种手段。正如保守派专栏作家、前纳粹代言人费迪南德·弗里德（Ferdinand Fried）1960年所言：“欧非的愿景升起在地平线上——而法国人已优雅地让旧的殖民遗产在一个新时代里继续活着。”
在大众的想象中，
是作为欧洲方案的一部分被强加给德国的，是为一体化、并在美国压力之下所接受的妥协。与持相同看法的荷兰人一起，德国的自由派领导人——首推艾哈德——继续寄望欧非会成为通向开放世界经济的一个过渡。为此，他们推动写入限制援助期限、并把非洲出口转向市场价格之时日锁定的条款——而随着年复一年，这些日期被一再推向更远的将来。
en: For the Germans,
was bound up with the geopolitical thinking of the Nazi era and its ideas of territorial zero-sum economic space.
In the Federal Republic,
was usually seen as a means for the French to sustain their colonial empire. As Ferdinand Fried, a conservative columnist and former Nazi mouthpiece, put it in 1960, “The vision of
rises on the horizon—and the French have elegantly kept their old colonial legacy alive in a new era.”
In the popular imagination,

was pushed on Germany as part of the European package, a compromise accepted for the sake of integration and under pressure from the United States. Along with the Dutch, who shared their opinions, the German liberal leaders, above all Erhard, continued to hope that Eurafrica would act as a transition to an open world economy. To this end, they pushed for clauses limiting the length of aid and locking in dates for the transition to market prices for African exports—dates that ended up being pushed ever farther into the future as the years passed.

zh: 艾森豪威尔政府一方则接受欧非，把它当作一种便利的手段，用以继续许诺非殖民化而不必朝它迈出具体步伐。
尽管标榜自由主义，美国最优先考虑的仍是法国与联邦德国之间达成协议——无论其形态如何；必要时甚至愿意容忍农业保护主义。欧洲的农业保护延续到1990年代，按一部专著的说法，它仍是欧洲“大体上以市场为导向的经济与贸易政策”的“最重要的背离”，它使“农民靠福利过活”。
具有讽刺意味的是，战后那个表面上自由贸易、反殖民主义的美国秩序所取得的第一个重大政策胜利，恰恰是一个按欧洲诸帝国的确切形状划出的受保护经济空间。
en: For its part, the Eisenhower administration accepted Eurafrica as a convenient means to continue to promise decolonization without taking concrete steps toward it.

Despite its professed liberalism, the United States placed highest priority on an agreement between the French and West Germans, regardless of the shape it took, and was even willing to tolerate agricultural protectionism if necessary. The protection of agriculture in Europe remained into the 1990s “the most important departure from the largely market-oriented economic and trade policies” of Europe, putting “farmers on welfare” as one monograph has it.
Ironically, the first significant policy victory of the ostensibly free-trade and anticolonial postwar U.S. order was a protected economic space in the exact shape of the European empires.

zh: 农业的例子表明，霸权者的权利就是打破规则的权利。正如美国一边宣扬自由贸易一边补贴本国农业，共同农业政策一边缔造了一个保护主义的欧洲，一边又开始向欧洲经济共同体的联系国施压，要求其出口转向世界市场价格。
塞内加尔驻布鲁塞尔大使杰梅·莫玛·盖耶（Djeme Momar Gueye）指出了其中的伪善：欧洲经济共同体“以经济自由主义之名施压‘联系国’放开其生产，自己却在光天化日之下保护其本国的农业生产”。
自由贸易的言辞有助于巩固六个签署国之间的关税同盟；但就农业而言，自由主义的原则止于欧洲经济共同体的边界——也就是马达加斯加的最南端。
en: The example of agriculture shows that the right of the hegemon is the right to break the rules. Just as the U.S. subsidized its agriculture while preaching free trade, the CAP created a protectionist Europe even as it began pressuring the EEC’s Associated States to transition their exports to world market prices.

Djeme Momar Gueye, the Senegalese ambassador to Brussels, pointed out the hypocrisy in the EEC pressuring the “Associated States to liberalize their production in the name of economic liberalism even as they protect their own agricultural production in broad daylight.”

Free-trade talk worked to cement the customs union among the six signatory nations, but in the case of agriculture, liberal principles stopped at the borders of the EEC—that is, on the southern tip of Madagascar.

zh: 欧洲、欧非与世界经济之间的冲突，关乎的是经济组织法则的普遍性。1961年，欧洲经济共同体委员会主席瓦尔特·哈勒斯坦（Walter Hallstein）为欧非辩护时，同时主张历史的重要性与非洲的根本差异性。他首先说，为了“一种世界主义的、不加区别的、人道主义的、没有焦点的政策”而无视殖民时代遗留下来的种种纽带，是没有意义的。不仅义务确实存在，而且西方的法则在此并不适用。他借用了物理学的一个比喻，说“在我们与发展中国家的关系中，我们正步入一个——不妨这么说——新的空间，它有自己的维度，而我们的欧几里得几何在其中已不再完全适用”。
欧洲怀疑论新自由主义者的反驳在于宣称：事实上同样的法则确实适用，而现代时代要求以经济上自我决定的民族国家这一形式实现平等。1961年，艾哈德领导下的联邦德国经济部写道，非洲的新国家“在经济上也必须实现真正的独立”。
针对欧洲经济共同体的特殊性，新自由主义者举起了关贸总协定那个普遍共同体的旗帜。
en: The conflict between Europe, Eurafrica, and the world economy was about the universality of the laws of economic organization. Defending

in 1961, the president of the European Commission, Walter Hallstein, argued for both the importance of history and the fundamental difference of Africa. He said first that it would not make sense to ignore the remaining ties from the colonial period “for the sake of a cosmopolitan, indiscriminate, humanitarian and unfocused policy.” Not only did obligations exist, but Western laws had no bearing. He used a metaphor from physics, saying that “in our relationship to the developing countries, we are entering, so to speak, a new space, which has its own dimensions, and in which our Euclidean geometry is no longer entirely applicable.”

The rebuttal of the Euroskeptic neoliberals consisted in claiming that, in fact, the same laws did apply and the modern era required equality in the form of the economically self-determining nation-state. The West German Economics Ministry under Erhard wrote in 1961 that the new states in Africa must “achieve true independence economically as well.”
Against the particularity of the EEC, the neoliberals held up the universal community of the GATT.

zh: 1950年代末，新自由主义者在一个想不到的地方——全球南方——为他们对欧洲一体化的批判找到了伙伴。从一开始，最公开批评欧洲经济共同体的便是亚洲、拉丁美洲以及非洲的非联系国。他们用来表达批评的论坛是关贸总协定。正是这家设在日内瓦的组织，成了发展中国家的所谓“局外”国家草拟一份含一百三十二个问题的追问清单、并向欧洲经济共同体各国传发以探询这一新经济政策性质之地。
在光谱的激进一端，1957年底在开罗召开的首届亚非团结大会宣称，欧洲共同市场把殖民地变成“六个欧洲国家的财产”，并“扼杀人民摆脱殖民统治、追求独立的愿望”。
较为温和的批评则来自联合国拉丁美洲经济委员会（ECLA，即拉美经委会）的拉美经济学家们和印度政府。他们的抱怨是：即便欧洲经济共同体的区域性安排符合关贸总协定法的条文，《罗马条约》中的保护主义也违背了它的自由主义精神。
美国既不愿触怒法德同盟——随着夏尔·戴高乐坚决反对英国加入欧洲经济共同体，这一同盟变得更加脆弱——也不愿把聚光灯打在自己那一整套农业补贴实践上；于是利益受损的发展中国家在奥地利和德国的新自由主义者那里找到了战术上的盟友。
en: In the late 1950s neoliberals found partners for their critique of European integration in the unlikely place of the Global South. From the beginning, it was actors from Asia, Latin America, and the non–Associated States of Africa who were most openly critical of the EEC. The forum they used to express their criticism was GATT. It was at the Geneva-based organization that the so-called “outsider” states of the developing countries drafted a probing list of 132 questions to be circulated to the EEC countries about the nature of the new economic policy.

At the radical end of the spectrum, at the first Afro-Asian Solidarity Conference, held at the end of 1957 in Cairo, the European Common Market was said to make colonies “the property of six European countries” and “strangle the aspirations of the people for independence from colonial domination.”

More moderately, Eurafrica was criticized by the Latin American economists at the United Nations Economic Commission for Latin America (ECLA) and by the government of India. Their complaint was that even if the EEC’s regional arrangement was in line with the letter of GATT law, the protectionism in the Treaty of Rome contradicted its liberal spirit.

With the United States unwilling to provoke the Franco-German alliance, which became even more tenuous with Charles De Gaulle’s staunch opposition to British membership in the EEC, and also unwilling to shine a spotlight on its own comprehensive practices of agricultural subsidies, the aggrieved nations of the developing world found tactical allies in Austrian and German neoliberals.

zh: 1957年发展中国家针对欧非的抗议，使一种更广泛的担忧具体显现出来，即朝鲜战争结束后世界范围内初级产品价格的持续下滑。1954年举行的一次审议，促使关贸总协定执行秘书于1957年11月召集一个由哈伯勒牵头的委员会展开调查。
《哈伯勒报告》通常被认定为关贸总协定以及如今的世贸组织历史上的一个重要转折点。
按执行秘书1958年1月致哈伯勒的任务书，报告应处理三项关切，它们都与发展中国家有关：第一，欠发达国家对世界市场初级产品价格波动的易感性；第二，发达国家与欠发达国家之间国际贸易增长上的差距；第三，也许“是所有问题中最大的一个”，即发达国家农业保护主义的持续存在。
尽管这项研究的用意在于回应发展中国家的关切，可供批评的却只有工业化国家的政策。
en: Protests from developing countries about Eurafrica in 1957 crystallized a wider concern about the worldwide decline in commodity prices after the end of the Korean War. A review session held in 1954 prompted the executive secretary of GATT to convene a committee in November 1957 led by Haberler to investigate.
The Haberler Report is routinely recognized as a major turning point in the history of both the GATT and now the WTO.

According to the secretary in his charge to Haberler in January, 1958, the report should address three concerns, all related to developing countries: first, the susceptibility of less-developed countries to fluctuations of commodity prices on the world market; second, the disparity in growth of international trade between more and less developed countries; and thirdly “perhaps the biggest problem of all,” the persistence of agricultural protectionism in developed countries.
Though the intention of the study was to address the concerns of developing countries, only the policies of industrialized countries would be open for criticism.

zh: 选由哈伯勒率领这个小组并不令人意外。自1930年代起任教于哈佛大学的他是国际贸易领域的首屈一指的专家，同时也是国家经济研究局（National Bureau of Economic Research，NBER）的主席。四人小组最终扩了员。新成员包括另外两位专家、同样是活跃的国联经济学家——米德，这位关贸总协定的设计者之一曾在制定英国战后充分就业政策中扮演关键角色，以及荷兰计量经济学家简·丁伯根（Jan Tinbergen），他在国联任职期间创建了第一个国民经济的宏观统计模型。加入他们的还有巴西经济学家罗伯托·坎波斯（Roberto Campos），他曾是本国出席布雷顿森林会议的代表之一，并出任巴西开发银行行长，其亲美政策为他赢得了“鲍勃·菲尔兹”（Bob Fields）的绰号。
另一位前国联经济学家汉斯·施泰勒（Hans Staehle）协助凑成了这个班子。专攻计量经济学的施泰勒曾任国联经济研究部主任，1930年代在日内瓦为国际劳工组织（International Labour Organization，ILO）起草报告，并就在国联的第一卷国际贸易成果与丁伯根磋商。
1950年代为关贸总协定工作的施泰勒就委员会的组成与哈伯勒通信。他们对委员会应当是什么样子持相同看法。例如，哈伯勒表示欣慰的是选了坎波斯而不是拉美经委会的劳尔·普雷维什（Raúl Prebisch）——后者虽是放开农产品贸易的主张者，却同样强硬地主张工业保护。
哈伯勒甚至提议彼得·T. 鲍尔（Peter T. Bauer），一位朝圣山学社同人，也是对第三世界工业化与对外援助两者都最激烈的批评者。
他大概意识到这走得太远，随后便提出米德作为折中人选。
en: The choice of Haberler to lead the team was not surprising. At Harvard University since the 1930s, he was a leading expert in international trade as well as chairman of the National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER). The four-person team eventually expanded. New members include two other experts and active League economists—Meade, an architect of GATT who had also played a key role in formulating Britain’s postwar full-employment policies, and the Dutch econometrician Jan Tinbergen, who created the first macroeconomic statistical model of a national economy while at the League. They were joined by Roberto Campos, a Brazilian economist who had been one of his nation’s delegates at Bretton Woods and the head of the Brazilian Development Bank, whose U.S.-friendly policies had earned him the nickname “Bob Fields.”

Another former League economist, Hans Staehle, had helped assemble the group. An econometrician by specialization, Staehle was a director of economic research at the League, drafting reports for the International Labour Organization (ILO) in Geneva in the 1930s and also consulted with Tinbergen on his first League volume on international trade.

Working for the GATT in the 1950s, Staehle corresponded with Haberler about the composition of the team. They shared a perspective on how the committee should look. Haberler expressed relief, for example, that Campos had been chosen instead of Raúl Prebisch of the ECLA, who was an advocate of liberalizing agricultural trade but also a strong advocate of industrial protection.
Haberler went so far as to suggest Peter T. Bauer, a fellow MPS member who was the most strident critic of both Third World industrialization and foreign aid.
Likely recognizing that this went too far, he then offered Meade as a compromise candidate.

zh: 哈伯勒无意让自己的报告被用作那些追求经济均等之规划的助推力量。他明确表示，报告摘要中提到“收入差距的进一步扩大”令他不满；他还进一步批评了“合意的”发展速度这一概念。
他写道，“这话当然不能这么直白地说”，但“欠发达国家习惯于把自己的政策带来的问题归咎于对外贸易和发展中国家”。
他还补说“委员会其他一些成员不会同意”，此处他想的可能是丁伯根与米德——两人所持观点都接近哈伯勒所反对的凯恩斯主义原则，而哈伯勒始终是稳定的坚定辩护者，认为稳定重于增长与充分就业两者。在1930年代至1980年代的著述中，哈伯勒一再坚持：开放的世界经济之所以重要，是因为它是管束可能引发通胀的社会支出与鲁莽工业化规划的手段——而发展中国家的潜在问题从未远离他的心头。
1990年代，保罗·萨缪尔森回忆起哈伯勒，称其为1950与1960年代主张“市场纪律”而非进口替代和国家主导发展的“少数派声音”。
en: Haberler had no intention for his report to be used as reinforcement for projects to achieve economic evenness. He said explicitly that he was unhappy with the reference to the “further increase in the income gap” in the report’s summary and further criticized the concept of a “desirable” rate of development.
He wrote that “it surely cannot be said so bluntly” but that that “underdeveloped countries are in the habit of blaming foreign trade and the developing countries for their own policies.”

He also added that “some other members of the committee will not agree,” thinking here likely of Tinbergen and Meade, both of whom held views close to the Keynesian principles opposed by Haberler, who remained a staunch defendant of stability over both growth and full employment. In his writings from the 1930s to the 1980s, Haberler insisted that the open world economy was important as a means of disciplining potentially inflationary social spending and rash projects of industrialization—and the potential problems of the developing nations were never far from his mind.
In the 1990s Paul Samuelson remembered Haberler as a “minority voice” for his advocacy of “market disciplines” rather than import substitution and state-driven development in the 1950s and 1960s.
