zh: 《哈伯勒报告》发表于1958年10月，它读起来简直像是二十五年前在日内瓦写成的。报告非但没有论证自由化妨碍了发展，反而得出结论：自由化走得还不够远。批评的具体靶子是工业化国家。仅在数月之前——1958年1月1日——才正式成立的欧洲经济共同体被单独点出，因为它把农业保护主义延伸到了联系领地，这将“引起对非洲和其他地方其他海外国家的歧视”。
除了批评刚刚启动的欧洲经济共同体，报告也抨击了农业补贴——这类补贴在美国尤为普遍——从而招致美国联邦储备委员会与美国农业部对报告的针对性反驳。
欧洲尤其被置为一个试金石。报告作者们警告：“如果欧洲经济共同体长成一个转移贸易、并加强针对域外农产品和其他商品的保护主义的工具，那它就可能成为滋生不良的、具有转移贸易与保护性质的歧视性安排的信号。”
发展中国家已经“认为，目前适用于商业政策与国际贸易的规则和惯例呈现出一种不利于它们利益的失衡”。
把欧非制度化，传递出的信息将是：规则就是用来打破的。
en: Published in October 1958, the Haberler Report could have been written in Geneva twenty-five years earlier. Far from arguing that liberalization hindered development, it concluded that liberalization had not gone far enough. The specific targets of criticism were the industrialized countries. The EEC, which formally came into existence only months earlier, on January 1, 1958, was singled out for extending agricultural protectionism to the associated territories, which would “give rise to discrimination against other overseas countries in Africa and elsewhere.”

Along with its criticism of the just-launched EEC, the report also assailed agricultural subsidies, which were especially widespread in the United States, leading to pointed rebuttals to the report from the U.S. Federal Reserve and the U.S. Department of Agriculture.

Europe, above all, was cast as a test case. “If the EEC were to grow into an instrument for trade-diversion and for increased protectionism against outside agriculture or other products,” the report’s authors warned, “it might be the signal for a growth of undesirable discriminatory arrangements of a trade-diverting and protective character.”

Developing countries were already “of the opinion that the rules and conventions which are at present applied to commercial policy and international trade show a lack of balance unfavorable to their interests.”
Institu-tionalizing Eurafrica would send a message that the rules were there to be broken.

zh: 关贸总协定执行秘书埃·温德姆·怀特（E. Wyndham White）告诉哈伯勒，报告获得了“巨大成功”，并“对我们这里关贸总协定的讨论产生了决定性的影响”。
关贸总协定欧洲办公室写道：“经济学家的一份报告很少受到如此热烈的欢迎与如此广泛的赞誉。”
施泰勒谈起“英国报刊上极为大量的报道”，称之为一次“巨大的轰动”。
对哈伯勒希望加以管束的那个群体——发展中国家——而言，报告尤其大受欢迎。1959年5月，十五个非洲、亚洲、加勒比与拉丁美洲国家（其中包括不结盟运动的领袖们——缅甸、加纳、马来亚、印度与印度尼西亚）提交了一份关于“国际贸易的扩展”的备忘录。
en: The executive secretary of the GATT, E. Wyndham White, told Haberler that the report had met with “great success” and “had a decisive effect on our discussions here in the GATT.”
“Very rarely,” GATT’s European office wrote, “had a report by economists been so warmly received and widely acclaimed.”
Talking about the “very considerable coverage in the British press,” Staehle called it an “enormous hit.”

The report was an especially large hit with the group that Haberler hoped to discipline: the developing countries. In May 1959 fifteen African, Asian, Caribbean, and Latin American nations, including leaders in the Non-Aligned Movement (Burma, Ghana, Malaya, India, and Indonesia), submitted a note on the “expansion of international trade.”

zh: 在它们的解读中，《哈伯勒报告》得出的结论是存在一种趋势，即“欠发达国家的出口贸易之扩展慢于高度工业化国家的贸易”，这意味着“必须尽早采取特别措施，在初级产品与制成品两个领域协助欠发达国家的贸易”。
加纳和印度尼西亚与巴西、英国一道，把《哈伯勒报告》用作反对欧非式优惠模式的武器。1990年代，世贸组织正是在这一问题上初试锋芒——美国就《洛美协定》提起诉讼，而《洛美协定》正是最初的欧非经济概念的后续产物。
在大众的想象中，这一案件被读作一个例子：美国的特定公司利益被藏匿在自由市场的普遍主义语言之中。
到2000年代，它将对日内瓦学派的新自由主义模式构成一大挑战。因此，看到加纳、印度尼西亚、印度这些后殖民初期的国家恰恰使用自由贸易的精确语汇、把《哈伯勒报告》当作杠杆，就更令人注目——它们援引报告，其意旨是欧洲经济共同体的优惠贸易安排“将造成贸易转移，而非贸易创造”。
en: In their interpretation, the Haberler Report had concluded that there was a tendency of “the export trade of the less developed countries to expand less rapidly than the trade of the highly industrialized countries,” meaning that “special measures to assist the trade of less developed countries both in the field of primary products and manufactured goods had to be taken very early.”

Ghana and Indonesia, along with Brazil and the United Kingdom, used the Haberler Report against the Eurafrican model of preference. In the 1990s the WTO would cut its teeth on precisely this issue as the United States brought cases against the Lomé agreement, a descendant of the original economic Eurafrica concept.
The case is read in popular imagination as an example of particular U.S. corporate interests being hidden in the universalist language of the free market.

It would present a major challenge to the Geneva School model of neoliberalism in the 2000s. Thus, it is all the more striking to see early postcolonial nations like Ghana, Indonesia, and India using the precise language of free trade with the Haberler Report as a lever, quoting it to the effect that the EEC’S preferential trade arrangements “will be trade-diverting rather than trade-creating.”

zh: 针对那个广为流传的陈词滥调——第三世界的诉求就等于要求关税的保护主义诉求——这些发展中国家实际上是在运用《哈伯勒报告》来反对保护主义、呼吁更自由的贸易。它们所列的“严重障碍”包括了自由贸易者的一切心头之患：“保护性配额、补贴与价格支持方案”以及数量限制。换句话说，它们并不是在要求通过设置壁垒保护“幼稚工业”、从而退出自由世界经济的权利。相反，它们是在要求关贸总协定——进而要求整个工业化世界——兑现其自身的自由贸易原则。朱利亚诺·加拉维尼（Giuliano Garavini）援引了1960年代法国人的抱怨：欠发达国家的代表们已被“自由主义学说所诱惑”。
对发展的要求、对欧洲与欧非的双重批判，都是用开放世界经济的话语提出的。
en: Against the frequently circulated cliché that Third World demands equaled the protectionist demands for tariffs, these developing nations were, in fact, using the Haberler Report to
protectionism and call for

trade. Their list of “serious obstacles” included all the bugbears of the free trader: “protective quotas, subsidies and price support schemes” and quantitative restrictions. In other words, they were not asking for the right to opt out of the free world economy through barriers to protect “infant industry.” Instead, they were requesting that the GATT—and by extension the industrialized world—live up to its own principles of free trade. Giuliano Garavini cites French complaints in the 1960s that the delegates from underdeveloped countries had been “seduced by liberal doctrine.”
The demand for development and the critique of both Europe and Eurafrica was being made in the language of the open world economy.

zh: 学者们常常对全球南方国家使用过于宽泛的定性，说它们是依附论意识形态的信奉者——依附论据说把保护幼稚工业置于一切之上，以实现经济多样化。
在那种叙述里，例外是与美国关系格外密切的国家——日本、台湾和韩国——它们的出口导向型工业化模式通常被视为预示了发展的方向：只要第三世界从依附论驱动的幻觉中醒悟过来，发展就会朝那个方向走。
看看对《哈伯勒报告》的回应便可知道，事实并非黑白分明。事实上，发展中国家同时既是保护的主张者，也是自由化的主张者。它们奉行的是“两者兼取”而非“非此即彼”的政策。这并不是保护主义的想象对阵自由贸易的想象、把发展中世界当作那个失败了的1930年代世界的落后维护者。恰恰相反，弱小的国家使用了它们手头一切可用的政策工具，其中包括关贸总协定。
就《哈伯勒报告》而言，发展中国家是用主人的工具来对付主人：它们建议欧洲和美国遵守自己那套反复宣扬的自由主义原则。《哈伯勒报告》表明，新自由主义观念的兴起与传播，必须看到全球南方国家如何有选择地采纳其中一些主张，把它们用作发展战略，才能理解。
en: Scholars often use overly broad characterizations of Global South countries as adherents to the ideology of dependency theory, which supposedly privileged the protection of infant industry above all else to diversify the economy.

In that narration, the exceptions are those countries with especially close ties to the United States—Japan, Taiwan, and South Korea—whose export-oriented industrialization models are usually seen as prefiguring the direction in which development would go once the Third World snapped out of its dependency-theory-driven delusions.

Looking at the response to the Haberler Report, one sees that the truth is less black-and-white. In fact, developing countries were advocates of both protection and liberalization at the same time. They followed a policy of “both-and” rather than “either-or.” It was not a protectionist imaginary against a free-trade imaginary, with the developing world as atavistic advocates of the failed 1930s world. Rather, weaker nations used all policy tools available to them, including GATT.

In the case of the Haberler Report, developing nations used the master’s tools against him by suggesting that Europe and the United States adhere to their own much-preached liberal principles. The Haberler Report shows that the rise and spread of neoliberal ideas can be understood only through its piecemeal adoption by Global South nations as a development strategy.

zh: 宪政主义者：《罗马条约》与多层级治理的诞生

children: THE TREATY OF ROME AS THE BIRTH OF MULTILEVEL GOVERNANCE

zh: 《罗马条约》在新自由主义知识分子的阵营中造成了一道关键的分裂。一边是那些赞成勒普克所称“普遍主义解决方案”的人。
正是那些在1930与1940年代提出联邦制与超国家解决方案的奥地利人和德国人反对欧洲一体化，他们担心一体化会妨碍关贸总协定那条更宏阔的路径，并导致法国统制主义（
）在西欧传染开来。《哈伯勒报告》本身便是一个显著个案，说明怀疑欧洲的新自由主义者不仅追念自1914年便已失去的“自下而上的自由主义”之回归，而且支持寻找一种新自由主义解方以保障开放的世界经济。
在《罗马条约》生效前数月提交美国国会的一份关于欧洲共同市场的报告中，哈伯勒强调需要加强关贸总协定，使之成为针对欧洲的“看门狗”。他写道：“美国以及其他局外者的利益（例如其他美洲国家与日本的利益），最能得到捍卫的场合便是在关贸总协定面前。”
在一个关键的举动中，哈伯勒不仅代表美国发言，也代表“局外者”发言。在同年出版的一部献给艾哈德的纪念文集中所写的一篇文章里，哈伯勒同样谈到局外者，包括“比欧洲贫穷得多的拉丁美洲国家”——它们将因欧洲的贸易歧视而受害，“并且没有理由平静地忍受这种伤害”。
哈伯勒主张，欧洲自己或许得利，“但整个世界经济却是输家”。
“至于歧视性一体化政策的替代选项，这个问题容易回答。替代选项就是：全面的贸易自由化［如关贸总协定所倡导者］。”
en: The Treaty of Rome produced a crucial split in the camp of neoliberal intellectuals. To one side were those who favored what Röpke called “universalist solutions.”

The very Austrians and Germans who had proposed federal and supranational solutions through the 1930s and 1940s opposed European integration, fearing that it would obstruct the broader approach of the GATT and lead to the contagion of French

in Western Europe. The Haberler Report itself was a banner case of how Euroskeptic neoliberals not only pined for the return of a “liberalism from below,” lost since 1914, but also backed the search for a neoliberal fix to secure the open world economy.

In a report about the European Common Market submitted to the U.S. Congress months before the Treaty of Rome came into force, Haberler emphasized the need to strengthen GATT as a “watchdog” against Europe. “It is before GATT,” he wrote, “that US and the interests of other outsiders (e.g. those of the other American states and Japan) can be best defended.”

In a key move, Haberler spoke on behalf of not only the United States but also “outsiders.” In a piece written in a festschrift for Erhard the same year, Haberler spoke similarly about the outsiders, including “Latin American countries, which are much poorer than Europe,” that will be injured by European trade discrimination “and had no reason to accept this injury calmly.”
Europe itself may profit, Haberler argued, “but the world economy as a whole loses.”
“The question about an alternative to discriminatory integration policy is easy to answer. The alternative is: overall trade liberalization [as advocated by GATT].”

zh: 尽管结果超出了哈伯勒原本的设想，他的报告还是在关贸总协定开启了一个新时代。作为《哈伯勒报告》的后续，缔约方在1958年11月的第十三届会议上决定设立三个委员会，审查为推动国际贸易扩展可采取的各类行动。
名为“第三委员会”的工作小组使关贸总协定与发展中国家之间的关系发生了“永久性转变”，转向有利于它们的市场准入要求。
在随后二十年里，发展中国家得以成功地利用关贸总协定游说豁免于非歧视的“纪律”，并获准偏离条约的严格约束。
有学者指出，哈伯勒公开反对把报告的发现解读为贸易条件恶化理论的证据，而是主张“更多贸易”从长期看会解决问题。
1964年，他自信地宣称：“欠发达国家极大地受益于世界贸易的扩展，‘工业中心’的繁荣已扩散到‘欠发达的边缘地区’。”未能增长得更快，是它们自己保护主义的过错。
颇具反讽意味的是，日内瓦学派试图通过《哈伯勒报告》锁定自由化贸易政策，结果却创造了恰恰相反的条件：为全球南方提供反对贸易规则一刀切适用的弹药。
en: Even against Haberler’s precise intentions, his report launched a new era at the GATT. As a follow-up to the Haberler Report, the contracting parties at their thirteenth session in November 1958 decided to establish three committees to examine various types of action to promote an expansion of international trade.
The working group called “Committee III” initiated a “permanent shift” in the GATT relationship to developing countries in favor of their demands for market access.

For the next two decades, the developing countries were able to use GATT successfully to lobby for exemptions from “disciplines” of nondiscrimination and for permission to deviate from the strictures of the treaty.

One scholar notes that Haberler openly opposed the interpretation of the report’s finding as proof for the theory of the declining terms of trade, arguing instead that “more trade” would solve the problem in the long run.

In 1964 he declared confidently that “the less developed countries have greatly benefited from the expansion of world trade and that the prosperity in ‘the industrial centers’ has spread to ‘the less developed periphery.’ ” Failure to grow more quickly was the fault of their own protectionism.

In a notable irony, the Geneva School attempt to lock in liberal trade policy through the Haberler Report ended up creating the conditions for the precise opposite: ammunition for a Global South argument against a one-size-fits-all application of trade rules.

zh: 第7章将会表明，为阻止这类偏离而改革关贸总协定，如何成为日内瓦学派新自由主义者的一项关键规划。但同样需要指出的是：正当一批新自由主义者攻击欧洲经济共同体之时，另一批人正在帮助创建它。事实上，在为欧洲经济共同体立宪的规划中，新自由主义者发展出一种制度解方，它能超越关贸总协定，因为它提供了监督机制，以及——最重要的——民族国家内部的执行机制。这个故事中的关键人物，是所谓秩序自由主义（ordoliberalism）“第二代”的两位成员：汉斯·冯·德·格罗本与恩斯特-约阿希姆·梅斯特马克。这些宪政主义者受的是法律训练而非经济学训练，这一点意味深长。他们主张，只要一部设计良好的条约创设出法律机制以遏制公共和私人经济权力的集中，经济一体化就能在没有政治一体化的情况下运转。弗朗茨·伯姆与瓦尔特·欧肯只在民族国家的层面谈论经济宪法，宪政主义者则提出，它可以放大到国际安排的尺度。
en: Chapter 7 will show how the reform of the GATT against just such deviations became an essential project for Geneva School neoliberals. Yet it is important to point out that just as one group of neoliberals was attacking the EEC, another was helping to create it. Indeed, in the project of constitutionalizing the EEC, neoliberals developed an institutional fix that would transcend the GATT by providing a mechanism of oversight and, most importantly, enforcement within the nation-state. The key figures in this story were two members of what are called the “second generation” of ordoliberals, Hans von der Groeben and Ernst-Joachim Mestmäcker. It is significant that these constitutionalists were trained as lawyers rather than economists. They argued that economic integration could work without political integration as long as a well-designed treaty created legal mechanisms to move against concentrations of public and private economic power. Whereas Franz Böhm and Walter Eucken had spoken of the economic constitution only at the level of the nation, the constitutionalists suggested it could be scaled up to international arrangements.

zh: 宪政主义者的工作是对哈耶克著述的一次有意识的运用——所依据的不是1930年代的著述，而是数十年之后的著述。从1960年代初起，哈耶克便开始建议把起草宪法当作一种手段，用以把经济自由锚固起来，抵御立法机关制定保护主义或再分配政策的企图。他在芝加哥大学任教期间撰写的《自由秩序原理》（The Constitution of Liberty）中已经开始了这一努力，但那本书对超国家组织的可能性仍然极其悲观：“在国际尺度上实行法治的道德基础似乎仍然全然不具备；而如果今天我们把政府的任何新权力交给超国家机构，我们大概会把法治在民族国家之内所带来的种种好处统统丧失掉。”
en: The work of the constitutionalists was a conscious application of Hayek’s work, not from the 1930s but from decades later. Beginning in the early 1960s, Hayek began to suggest using the drafting of constitutions as a way to anchor economic freedoms against the attempts of legislatures to enact protectionist or redistributive policies. He had begun this effort in

which he wrote while he was at the University of Chicago, but this book was still extremely pessimistic about the possibilities of supranational organization: “The moral foundations for a rule of law on an international scale seem to be completely lacking still, and we should probably lose whatever advantages it brings within the nation if today we were to entrust any of the new powers of government to supra-national agencies.”

zh: 移居德国之后，哈耶克软化了这一立场。如他所指出的，问题在于“如何把这些权力在权威的各个层级之间加以划分”。
1962年6月，哈耶克在弗莱堡大学——欧肯与伯姆最初任教的学术机构——就其新教职发表就职演讲，回忆起自己在维也纳受训时法律与经济学一同攻读的情形。“人有时不禁要问，”他说，“法学教育与经济学教育的分离，会不会终究是个错误。”
法律的重要性在他的陈述过程中变得清晰。他宣布，自己此后的关注点将是“经济政策的问题”。
然而，由于人类知识的限度——自1930年代末以来这便是他的主题——政策不能建立在宏观经济学那些“错误的”总量与预测之上：“要想在任何一个点上成功地进行干预，我们就必须知道整个经济的所有细节，不只知道我们本国的细节，而且要知道整个世界的细节。”
数字的世界已被永久性地声名扫地，成为天真者与口是心非者的领地。鉴于知识分布在无数行动者之中，哈耶克说，“因此经济政策的主要任务似乎就在于创设一种框架，在这个框架之内，个人不仅能够自由决定自己要做什么，而且他基于自己掌握的具体知识所作的决定也能尽可能多地有助于总产出”。
归根结底，“我们实际上所能贡献的只有原则而已”。
en: On moving to Germany, Hayek softened this position. The problem, as he had noted, was “how to divide these powers between the tiers of authority.”

In his inaugural speech of June 1962 for his new position at the University of Freiburg, the original institutional home of Eucken and Böhm, Hayek reminisced about having learned law alongside economics during his training in Vienna. “One is sometimes tempted to ask,” he said, “whether the separation of legal and economic studies was not perhaps, after all, a mistake.”
The importance of law became clear in the course of his presentation. He pronounced that his focus would henceforth be on “problems of economic policy.”

Yet because of the limits of human knowledge, which had been his theme since the late 1930s, policy could not be based on the “erroneous” aggregates and forecasts of macroeconomics: “In order to interfere successfully on any point, we would have to know all the details of the whole economy, not only of our own country but of the whole world.”

The world of numbers had been permanently discredited as the domain of the naive and the disingenuous. Given the distribution of knowledge among innumerable actors, Hayek said, “the chief task of economic policy would thus appear to be the creation of a framework within which the individual not only can freely decide for himself what he wants to do, but in which also this decision based on his particular knowledge will contribute as much as possible to aggregate output.”
In the end, “principles are practically all that we have to contribute.”

zh: 哈耶克援引欧肯引入的那个术语，指出原则与措施两者都必须符合系统（systemgerecht），也就是“与整个系统相一致”。
对哈耶克而言，最高的价值事实上并非个人自由——除非它是维持整个系统再生产和生产力所必需的条件。经济政策与其说是寻求对经济本身的全面概览（那是不可能的），不如说是设定框定经济活动的规则。确定这一框架的性质，必然把人引向超出这门学科通常视野的人类行为与治国术的领域，这也正是为什么——用他的话说——“只做经济学家的人不可能成为好的经济学家”。
照料系统，把经济学的任务变成了制度设计的任务。
en: Invoking the term introduced by Eucken, Hayek said both principles and measures would have to be
or “in conformity with the whole system.”

The highest value for Hayek was not, in fact, individual freedom except insofar as it was a functional necessity for the overall reproduction and productivity of the system itself. Economic policy had more to do with setting the rules that would frame economic activity than with seeking a comprehensive overview of the economy itself, which was impossible. Ascertaining the nature of this framework necessarily led into realms of human behavior and statecraft beyond the normal ken of the discipline, which why, as he put it, “he who is only an economist cannot be a good economist.”
Tending the system turned the task of economics into the task of institutional design.

zh: 哈耶克思想的核心，是他与卡尔·施米特共有的一组区分：法（Recht）与立法（Gesetz）。与施米特一样，哈耶克相信由民选政府来创制法律，正在使法治国（
）蜕变为立法国（Gesetzesstaat）。
他写道：“全能民主之政府的弱点，被这位非凡的德国政治研究者卡尔·施米特看得非常清楚；在1920年代，他大概比大多数人更了解那种正在成形的政府形态的性质。”
他援引施米特1932年文章的论点：多元主义的政党国家变成“总体国家”，不是出于力量与强力，而是出于软弱——它干预生活的一切领域，因为它觉得自己必须满足所有利害方提出的要求。
换言之，哈耶克把“不受限的”（或米塞斯所称“全能的”）民主看作循着一种俘获逻辑走向极权主义。他从1960年起在宪法设计上的种种努力，就是要为民主偏离经济秩序、转向特殊利益寻租的倾向找到制度解方；正如亚历山大·拉斯托（Alexander Rüstow）所说，国家政策和国家预算正在变成特殊利益的“猎物”。
en: Central to Hayek’s thinking was a distinction he shared with Carl Schmitt, between law
and legislation
Like Schmitt, Hayek believed that the creation of law by democratically elected state governments was leading to a degeneration of the
into a Ge
or legislative state.

He wrote that “the weakness of the government of an omnipotent democracy was very clearly seen by the extraordinary German student of politics, Carl Schmitt, who in the 1920s probably understood the character of the developing form of government better than most people.”

He quoted Schmitt’s essay from 1932 to the effect that “a pluralist party state will become ‘total’ not from strength and force but out of weakness: it intervenes in all sectors of life, because it feels it has to fulfill the demands of all interested parties.”

In other words, Hayek saw “unlimited” (or what Mises called “omnipotent”) democracy as leading to totalitarianism out of a logic of capture. His efforts at constitutional design from 1960 onward were attempts to discover an institutional fix for the tendency of democracy to stray from economic order toward particularist rent-seeking and, as Alexander Rüstow put it, the transformation of state policy and national budgets into the “prey” of special interests.

zh: 他首先在多特蒙德商会的一次演说中提出这一制度构想的基本框架，演说刊于《法兰克福汇报》（Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung）。他提议把立法机构分为两院：一院由民选代表组成，处理国家的日常事务，他称之为“执政者”（telothetes）；另一院称“立法者”（nomothetes），由四十至五十五岁的人选组成，由其同侪选出，任期十五年。
他设想，立法者因任期长久而可以隔断利益集团的压力，负责法律的创制与解释。哈耶克主张，这样一种制度变革可以用作手段，“缓慢地生成一种超国家秩序，在这一秩序中，所有民族国家政府都可以追求实际目标，同时仍受制于共同规则，而这些规则同时保护公民不受其统治者恣意的侵害”。
在这一他后来称为“有限民主”的模型中，哈耶克经由制度设计，为1930年代的超国家可能性重开了一扇门。
en: He laid out the parameters of this institutional concept first in a speech at the Chamber of Commerce in Dortmund, published in the

He proposed a bicameral legislature divided into elected legislators tasked with everyday business of state, who he called “telothetes,” and another set of legislators called “nomothetes” of ages forty to fifty-five elected by their peers to fifteen-year terms.

Putatively insulated from the pressures of interest groups by the length of their terms, the nomothetes would be responsible for the creation and interpretation of law. Hayek argued that such a change of institutions could be used as a means for “the slow production of a supranational order, in which all national governments could pursue practical goals while still being subordinated to common rules that would simultaneously protect citizens from the arbitrariness of their rulers.”
In this model of what he later called “limited democracy,” Hayek opened a door back to the supranational possibilities of the 1930s through institutional design.

zh: 哈耶克到弗莱堡任教，使秩序自由主义的取向发生转移，不再关注完全竞争——到1960年代初，他对完全竞争已公开表示怀疑。
新的方向指向“作为发现过程的竞争”这一观念。
冯·德·格罗本在欧洲经济共同体委员会主管竞争事务后，也开始用类似的术语为自己的工作立论。冯·德·格罗本生于1907年，几乎比哈伯勒、哈耶克、勒普克、罗宾斯这批日内瓦学派元老小近十岁。1965年他写道，一方面，“构成市场的那些人的经济计划之间的协调，要靠市场经济中诸力量的博弈来实现”，但这件事必须在一个制度框架内发生。
其中最重要的是“竞争政策——它并不意味着自由放任，而意味着建成一种基于法律的秩序”。
在他自己的叙述里，《罗马条约》“尤其是其中的竞争规则，是符合新自由主义理念的”。
en: Hayek’s arrival in Freiburg reoriented ordoliberalism away from concerns with perfect competition, about which he was openly skeptical by the early 1960s.
The new direction was toward the idea of “competition as a discovery process.”

As von der Groeben took up his position in the European Commission for Competition, he began to theorize his work in similar terms. Born in 1907, von der Groeben was almost a decade younger than the original Geneva School neoliberals Haberler, Hayek, Röpke, and Robbins. In 1965 he wrote that, on the one hand, “coordination of the economic programs of those who constitute the market is to be achieved by the play of forces in a market economy” but that this needed to happen within an institutional framework.
The most important aspect was “competition policy [which] does not mean laissez-faire, but the achievement of an order based on law.”
In his own telling, in the Treaty of Rome, “the rules of competition in particular were in accordance with neoliberal ideas.”

zh: 新自由主义原则如何被写入条约，需要细加梳理；学者们强调，条约的竞争条款远不是新自由主义教条的复写本。
从签字那一刻起就很清楚：《罗马条约》只是一个有待政治方向去塑造的法律框架。
条约最初涉及竞争的条文（第85、86条）相当宽泛，没有给欧洲法院明确的角色。事实上，条约在竞争问题上只是临时性的，把澄清工作推迟三年（第87条）。不过，冯·德·格罗本主持起草了后来成为条约实施条例的那份规章，它于1962年通过，并明确以联邦德国1950年代末生效的竞争立法为蓝本。
“第17号条例”措辞严厉得多，尤其在罚款与处罚事项上授予法院的“完全管辖权”。更新后的条例赋予委员会以覆盖整个共同体的卡特尔监督权，并要求直接向委员会申报——尽管并未同时给予跟进所需的行政能力。
然而，出于对法国压力的让步，仍留下若干关键豁免——农业、国防工业、运输和核能。
在一项关键增补中，第17号条例还规定，有权提起诉讼的不仅是成员国，还包括“主张正当利益的自然人或法人”（第3条）。
en: How neoliberal principles were enshrined in the treaty takes some unpacking, and scholars have emphasized that its competition provisions were far from carbon copies of neoliberal doctrine.
From the moment of its signing, it was clear that the Treaty of Rome was only a framework of law to be shaped by political direction.

The original articles in the treaty related to competition (Articles 85 and 86) were rather broad and did not give a clear role to the European Court of Justice. In fact, the treaty was only provisional on the matter of competition and postponed clarification for three years (Article 87). However, von der Groeben oversaw what would become the regulation implementing the treaty that passed in 1962. The regulation was modeled explicitly on those of West Germany, which entered force in the late 1950s.

Regulation 17 was worded much more strongly, especially in the “unlimited jurisdiction” it granted to the court in matters of fines and penalties. The updated regulation gave the Commission new authorities of community-wide surveillance over cartels and required notification directly to the Commission—if not the administrative capacity to follow up.
In deference to French pressure, however, there would still be crucial exemptions—for agriculture, defense industry, transport, and nuclear energy.
In a critical addition, Regulation 17 also granted the right to bring cases not only to member states but to “natural or legal persons who claim a legitimate interest” (Article 3).

zh: 德国新自由主义者很早就把竞争政策视为中心，而法国人则把它看成一组弹性原则。
用梅斯特马克（Mestmäcker）的话说，冯·德·格罗本及其团队的目标很明确：“要做的，是让《欧共体条约》的经济宪法活起来。”
梅斯特马克是把《罗马条约》的效应以哈耶克式的治理模式加以理论化的关键人物。他生于1926年，比日内瓦学派第一代整整晚了一代人。作为所谓“高射炮辅助员”（Flakhelfer）一代，他青年时代的决定性经验不是第一次而是第二次世界大战，大萧条对他至多是童年里模糊的记忆。梅斯特马克在弗莱堡大学师从伯姆（Böhm），并在整个职业生涯中不断向导师的著作致敬。有学者称他是“秩序自由主义第二代的代表人物”。
他的正式教职在萨尔大学，但1960至1970年间担任欧洲经济共同体委员会特别顾问。梅斯特马克认为，共同体法中“不受扭曲的竞争”这一目标，“在政治上是重视可以通过法律塑造经济制度的可能性的最重要后果——在德国，这一认识首先由瓦尔特·欧肯和弗朗茨·伯姆提出”。它把秩序自由主义对法律的重视与哈耶克“作为发现方法的竞争”结合起来。
梅斯特马克声称，他从伯姆那里接受了这样一个观念：任何一种经济秩序都是政治决定的结果。
他是把哈耶克与伯姆结合起来、并把经济宪法放大到超国家层面的最重要人物。
en: From early on, German neoliberals saw competition policy as central even when the French saw it in terms of flexible principles.
As Mestmäcker put it, the goal for von der Groeben and his team was clear: “it was about bringing the economic constitution of the EEC Treaty to life.”

Mestmäcker was the key figure in theorizing the repercussion of the Rome treaty as a model of governance in Hayekian terms. Born in 1926, he was a whole generation younger than the original cohort of the Geneva School. Part of the so-called Flakhelfer generation, his defining young experience was not of the First but of the Second World War, and the Great Depression would have been only a dim memory from childhood. Mestmäcker studied with Böhm at the University of Freiburg and paid homage to the work of his mentor throughout his career. One scholar calls him the “leading representative of the second generation of ordoliberals.”

His professional position was at the University of Saarland, but he was special adviser to the European Commission from 1960 to 1970. Mestmäcker saw the goal of “undistorted competition” in European Community law as “politically the most important effect of the appreciation of the legal shapability of the economic system, which in Germany was first recognized by Walter Eucken and Franz Böhm.” It managed to combine the ordoliberal attention to law with Hayek’s idea of “competition as a method of discovery.”
Mestmäcker claimed to take from Böhm the idea that every economic order is the outcome of a political decision.
He was the most important figure in combining Hayek with Böhm and scaling up the economic constitution to the suprastate level.

zh: 面对战后欧洲联邦的前景，哈伯勒和其他日内瓦学派新自由主义者曾带着忧郁唤起国际联盟的幽灵，主张不愿让渡主权注定使任何真正的经济一体化尝试归于失败。1965年的一篇论文中，梅斯特马克同样回溯国联——但目的是论证欧洲已经找到超越它的制度解方。他回忆起1927年的世界经济会议，克莱夫·莫里森-贝尔曾在那次会议上展示他的关税壁垒地图。国联在那次会议上提议，以各国交出主权为基础对管制措施实行国际调节，但这一建议“被斥为极端，以至于会议内外‘任何讲道理的人’都不会接受”。梅斯特马克写道，想到共同体法，“很难找到一个如此精确的‘无心预言’的可比先例”。
en: Gazing at the prospects for federation in postwar Europe, Haberler and other Geneva School neoliberals had invoked the ghost of the League of Nations with melancholy, arguing that an unwillingness to surrender sovereignty doomed any genuine attempt at economic integration. In a 1965 article Mestmäcker also harked back to the League—but in order to argue that Europe had found the institutional fix to transcend it. He recalled the World Economic Conference of 1927, where Clive Morrison-Bell had displayed his tariff walls map. At that gathering, the League had proposed the idea of international regulation of controls on the basis of the surrender of individual national sovereignty, but the proposal was “rejected as so extreme that ‘no reasonable person’ inside or outside the conference would stand for it.” When one thinks about European Community law, Mestmäcker wrote, “it would be difficult to find a comparable case of involuntary prophecy” so precise.

zh: 换言之，欧共体不仅实现了国联失落的承诺，而且超出了它。梅斯特马克援引莱昂内尔·罗宾斯战间期关于联邦制的著作，引其1937年论国际秩序的那本书说，关税同盟的作用是降低各成员个体的“自主性”。
梅斯特马克正确地指出，欧共体模式的独特性质，在于它致力于“通过法律”建立一个政治共同体。
在《罗马条约》的谈判中，很难单独辨认出哈耶克思想的存在，但在梅斯特马克的著作中可以清楚看到它。1973年他援引哈耶克的“结论：自由制度之所以可能，只因放弃相机处置的政策，并把国家的一切行动约束于一般的、由宪法所保障的法律原则”。
他后来加以阐发时写道，他把哈耶克的工作视为对“欧肯关于法律秩序与经济秩序相互依赖之理论”的扩展。
他以“经济宪政”的眼光看待欧洲一体化，认为《罗马条约》是创设这种安排的起点。
对梅斯特马克来说最重要的事实是，条约的目标在于“把对国家间贸易的管制，从一国经济政策的工具箱中排除出去”。
en: The EEC, in other words, had not only realized the lost promise of the League of Nations but surpassed it. Mestmäcker referred to Lionel Robbins’s interwar federal writing, quoting his 1937 book on international order to the effect that customs unions work to decrease the “autonomy” of individual members.
Mestmäcker argued correctly that the distinctive nature of the EEC model was its investment in creating a political community “by means of the law.”

It is difficult to find the presence of Hayek’s thought per se in the negotiations of the Treaty of Rome, but one can see it clearly in the work of Mestmäcker. In 1973 he cited Hayek’s “conclusion that a free system is possible only be renunciation of discretionary policy and by binding all action of the state to general, constitutionally guaranteed legal principles.”
As he elaborated later, he saw Hayek’s work as an expansion on “Eucken’s theory of the interdependence of the legal and economic orders.”
Seeing European integration through the lens of “economic constitutionalism,” he felt that the Treaty of Rome was a starting point for creating such an arrangement.
Most important to Mestmäcker was the fact that the goal of the treaty was to “exclude control of interstate trade as an instrument of national economic policy.”

zh: 国家主权已被《罗马条约》悄然掏空。权力朝两个方向配置：向上与向下。向上，委员会获得制定关税政策的权力；更重要的是，竞争总司获得监督权，并可能采取反垄断措施。向下，欧共体确认了新的私人权利。欧共体的“法律主体”“不仅是成员国，而且包括个人”。
用法律术语说，这意味着《罗马条约》是“自行执行”（self-executing）并具有“直接效力”（directly effective）。梅斯特马克说：“一旦冲突发生，国内法必须让路。”
正如我们在第7章将看到的，这后来成为日内瓦学派新自由主义者所谓“多层级治理”（multilevel governance）的内核。
en: National sovereignty had been pickpocketed by the Treaty of Rome. Power was granted in two directions: upward and downward. In the upward direction, the Commission was given the power to make tariff policy. Even more importantly, the Directorate General for Competition was given the capacity of oversight and potentially antitrust measures. In the downward direction, the EEC enshrined new private rights. The “legal subjects” of the EEC were “not only the Member States but also individuals.”
In legal jargon, this meant the Rome treaty was “self-executing” and was “directly effective.” As Mestmäcker put it, “if a conflict arises national law must give way.”
As we will see in Chapter 7, this became the core of what would later be theorized by Geneva School neoliberals as “multilevel governance.”

zh: 艾哈德反对欧洲一体化，关键在于他作为一位尽职的政治家，不愿把国家主权交给一个超国家实体。
相形之下，这恰恰是欧共体之于梅斯特马克的价值所在。共同体法的关键在于它高于国内法，使“成员国公民受共同体法律的管辖”。
梅斯特马克对该理论的阐发基于两条原则：法院排除与共同体法相抵触的国内法适用的权力，以及个人直接向法院提出主张的能力。他在1965年写道，欧洲共同体是“国际法上的一个新法律实体，其法律主体不仅是成员国，而且包括个人”。
en: Critical for Erhard’s opposition to European integration had been his unwillingness, as a good statesman, to relinquish national sovereignty to a supranational entity.

By contrast, this was precisely what made the EEC valuable to Mestmäcker. The critical aspect of European Community law was that it superseded national law, making “the citizens of the member states subject to the law of the community.”

Mestmäcker’s elaboration on the theory was based on two principles: the power of the court to overrule national law and the ability of individuals to make claims directly to the court. As he wrote in 1965, the European Community was a “new legal entity in International Law whose legal subjects are not only the Member States but also individuals.”

zh: 梅斯特马克写道，共同体法“第一次”提供了抵御“经济权力与政府无能”的手段，并“在领土范围上扩展公共权力的有效边界”。
这使公法与私法得以分离，它给市场参与者提供了一个在本国之外的申诉场合——如今可以直接向共同体层面申诉。梅斯特马克提请注意这样一些情形：“市场准入被阻止或受阻，［这些情形］使保护个人自由成为竞争规则的任务。”
en: Mestmäcker wrote that European Community law offered “for the first time” a means to fend off “economic power and government impotence” and “expand territorially the sphere of effectiveness of public power.”

What this permitted was the separation of public and private law, providing market actors a forum beyond their own state to make their appeals—directly now to the community level. Mestmäcker drew attention to those cases “in which access to the market is prevented or obstructed [which] make the protection of individual freedom a task of competition rules.”

zh: 权力的两向配置——上至共同体、下至个人——是宪政主义者解读欧洲的要害。在新自由主义宪政主义者看来，欧洲是一个保障私人权利、由欧洲法院加以执行的“超国家法律秩序”。
在梅斯特马克对哈耶克、伯姆与罗宾斯的综合中，重点不在委员会的监督权力，而在那种把公民置于欧洲与民族国家这两重嵌套主权之内的法律关系。从个人直通欧洲法院的纵向法律关系，开辟出一条绕开国家主权的不当行使、确保从事贸易这一人权的通道。
en: The bifurcation of powers, upward to the community and down to the individual was essential to the constitutionalist reading of Europe. To neoliberal constitutionalists, Europe was a “supranational legal order” securing private rights enforceable by the European Court of Justice.

In Mestmäcker’s synthesis of Hayek, Böhm, and Robbins, the emphasis is not on the surveillance rights of the Commission but on the legal relationship that placed the citizen inside the twin nested sovereignties of Europe and nation. The vertical legal relationship created from the individual to the European Court of Justice created an avenue to elude deviant exercises of national sovereignty and secure the human right to trade.

zh: 梅斯特马克、伯姆与施米特：经济宪法与决断

children: THE ECONOMIC CONSTITUTION AND THE DECISION

zh: 新自由主义关于欧洲的讨论有一个重要转折点：1964年，《罗马条约》的竞争规则取得第一次重大胜利，欧洲法院维持了禁止德国生产商格伦迪希（Grundig）与荷兰经销商孔茨滕（Consten）之间协议的决定。
冯·德·格罗本称格伦迪希—孔茨滕案是一桩“轰动”。
正是在此案之后，梅斯特马克开始把《欧共体条约》看作具有宪法品质，凭此竞争法能够保护“个人自由”，甚至免于来自本国政府的侵害。
他后来宣称，该条约“体现了一部经济宪法”。
“经济宪法”概念由欧肯与伯姆在1930年代首先使用，有两重含义：它既是对既定社会现实的描述，也是对期望中的法律秩序的规范。
秩序自由主义者说“经济宪法”，主要不是取其字面形态，也不认为它必须载于某份根本法律文件之中。
这一点解释了为什么伯姆对1940年代有关联邦德国《基本法》的争论未给予特别关注。在新自由主义者看来，《基本法》不是一部“经济宪法”，因为它并未体现设立某种特定经济秩序的决定，而只是偏自由派的立场与社会民主派立场妥协的产物。
一部真正的经济宪法所需要的，是对经济秩序的统一构想，而这一构想首先是在与魏玛共和国种种妥协的对照中界定出来的。
en: An important turning point for the neoliberal discussion on Europe came in 1964 when the competition rules of the Treaty of Rome had their first significant victory as the European Court of Justice upheld the prohibition of an agreement between the German producer Grundig and the Dutch retailer Consten.
Von der Groeben called the Grundig-Consten case a “sensation.”

It was after this case that Mestmäcker began to consider the EEC Treaty as having constitutional qualities by which competition law might protect “individual freedom” even against one’s own national government.
He declared later that the treaty “embodies an economic constitution.”
Used first by Eucken and Böhm in the 1930s, the concept of an economic constitution had two meanings. It was both descriptive of a given sociological reality and normative of a desired legal order.
Ordoliberals did not mean “economic constitution” primarily in the literal form nor did they assume that it had to be embodied in a founding legal document.

The fact explains why Böhm gave no particular attention to the debates about the West German Basic Law in the 1940s. In the minds of neoliberals, the Basic Law was not an “economic constitution” because it did not embody a decision establishing a specific economic order, but instead was the outcome of compromise between more liberal and social democratic positions.
What was necessary for a genuine economic constitution was the unity of vision for an economic order, as defined first against the compromises of the Weimar Republic.

children: 〔编者注〕原书写作1964年并将孔茨滕称为荷兰经销商。欧共体委员会于1964年9月23日作出决定，欧洲法院于1966年7月13日作出判决，维持核心竞争法认定，并部分撤销将协议整体定为违法的决定。孔茨滕是法国经销商。
〔编者注〕原书写作1964年并将孔茨滕称为荷兰经销商。欧共体委员会于1964年9月23日作出决定，欧洲法院于1966年7月13日作出判决，维持核心竞争法认定，并部分撤销将协议整体定为违法的决定。孔茨滕是法国经销商。

zh: 伯姆把经济宪法说成一项“根本决断”，这说法直接取自卡尔·施米特；施米特在1928年把宪法描述为“关于政治统一体的本性与形式的全面决定”。
1937年，伯姆把它表述为“国民经济的规范秩序”，它必须通过“有意识、有自觉的政治意志的行使、领导者作出的权威决断”才能成立。
他使用的军事隐喻值得整段引用。他宣称：“再也不容许有任何沉默的生长，任何在经济自身怀中、亦即自下而上的有序形成。这样的社会巴别塔建得如此之高、速度如此之快，只会造成不神圣的语言混乱——除非那唯一能够代表统一要素的秩序理念，把包括最末节在内的一切照亮；除非秩序理念立足于这样一句号令：一切听我指挥！”
en: Böhm took the description of the economic constitution as a “fundamental decision” directly from Carl Schmitt, who in 1928 described the constitution as a “comprehensive decision concerning the nature and form of the political unit.”

In 1937 Böhm described it as “a normative order of the national economy” that must come into being through the exercise of a “conscious and aware political will, an authoritative decision of leadership.”

He used martial metaphors that are worth quoting at length, declaring that “there is no longer any space for a silent growth, for an orderly formation of things out of the lap of the economy itself, that is, from the bottom up. Social Babels built of such great height and at such an accelerated tempo produce an unholy confusion of languages unless the idea of order that alone can represent the element of unity illuminates the totality down to its last details, unless the idea of order is based on the sentence: everything at my command!”

zh: 伯姆的隐喻与哈耶克的格格不入。哈耶克明确反对这样一种想法：社会秩序可以按照战场、军队或单个企业内部的同一模式来组织。
正如第7章将详细阐述的，哈耶克的自发秩序或“生长出来的”秩序观念，把信念寄托在那些“人的行动的结果、但不是人为设计的结果”的交往形式上。
然而，即使1960年代的新自由主义者从哈耶克的宪法设计建议中获得启发，他们也对他在真正的实施环节上的疏忽感到不满。尽管他做了种种宪法设计的操演，哈耶克始终没有说明：在不陷入他所批评的“建构主义”谬误的前提下，这些设计如何付诸实行。
en: Böhm’s metaphors clash with those of Hayek, who specifically opposed the idea that social order followed the same model of organization as the battlefield, in the army, or inside a single firm.

As will be described in detail in Chapter 7, Hayek’s ideas of spontaneous or “grown” orders put faith in the notion of forms of human interaction that were “the result of human action but not of human design.”

Yet even as they were inspired by Hayek’s proposals for constitutional design in the 1960s, neoliberals were frustrated by his inattention to the actual moment of implementation. For all his exercises in constitutional design, Hayek did not explicitly explain how they could be brought into action without the fallacy of what he called “constructivism.”

zh: 梅斯特马克把《罗马条约》描述为哈耶克命题的实现——必须“以宪法所保障的法律原则”来约束国家。
但他也看到，法律的一个弱点在于它无法承认自身这门学科的政治性。
他转向施米特以求对治。施米特在考察自由思想的演进时曾主张，十九世纪是政治与经济各自自主的空间得以创生的时代。梅斯特马克则认为，施米特的失误在于把自由主义的学说按其自我表述当了真。对自由主义者来说，正是那种表面上的去政治化本身构成了政治工程。但这并不等于说他们认为这件事已经完成。经济的持续去政治化是一场延续不断的法律斗争，它要求不断创新的制度来护卫竞争的空间。
en: Mestmäcker described the Treaty of Rome as a realization of the propositions of Hayek’s argument for the need to bind the state through “constitutionally guaranteed legal principles.”
Yet he saw that one of the weaknesses of law was its inability to acknowledge the politics of its own discipline.

He turned to Schmitt to help counter this. Looking at the evolution of liberal thought, Schmitt had argued that the nineteenth century was a time of the creation of an autonomous space of politics and economics. Mestmäcker argued that Schmitt erred by taking the doctrine at its word. For liberals, it was the apparent depoliticization that was the political project itself. Yet this should not lead to the conclusion that liberals felt this was a completed process. The ongoing depoliticization of the economic was a continual legal struggle, one that required continual innovation in the creation of institutions capable of safeguarding the space of competition.

zh: 施米特主张，自由主义对政治的否认并没有使政治消失，只是掩盖了一个更为根本的敌／友区分。在自由主义声称代表全人类的表述里，自由主义的任何反对者都不再只是对手，而成了人类本身的敌人。梅斯特马克接受这一刻画，并由此指出：这恰恰说明自由主义切不可否认自身的政治本性。针对哈耶克在过渡时刻问题上的讳莫如深，梅斯特马克主张坦然承认，自由市场原则需要“决断论式”地奠基于政治意志的行为之中。他写道，忽视决断的重要性，就是错过“不受扭曲的竞争这一体系的政治意义”。
en: Schmitt contended that the disavowal of politics in liberalism did not make politics disappear but only concealed a fundamental friend /enemy distinction that was all the more elemental. In the liberal claim to speak for humanity at large, any of liberalism’s enemies became not only opponents but enemies of humanity as such. Mestmäcker accepted his characterization and claimed that this was precisely why liberalism must not disavow its own political nature. Against Hayek’s reticence about the moment of transition, Mestmäcker argued for openness about the need for the “decisionistic” grounding of free-market principles in acts of political will. To overlook the importance of the decision, he wrote, was to miss “the political meaning of the system of undistorted competition.”

zh: 梅斯特马克从施米特那里得到的教益是：必须始终意识到新自由主义使经济去政治化这一工程本身明确的政治性质。他的立场得到另一位第二代新自由主义者埃里希·霍普曼的支持。霍普曼生于1923年，是梅斯特马克的同代人，在哈耶克退休之后接任了他在弗莱堡的教席。他把那种“经济不过是一架由无涉政治的看护者加以维护的机器”的说法斥为虚构。既然每一种经济组织形态都以关于结果的先在决定为前提，那么“经济政策的表面去政治化”只是掩盖了被否认掉的价值判断。
他援引哈耶克的论点：把经济想象成一架机器式的、无政治的实体，这本身就是关于市场社会如何能够运转的一种预设。他批评欧肯落入陷阱，把经济的“自主性”看成已然实现的结果，并且幻想“完全竞争”的可能性。
与梅斯特马克和冯·德·格罗本一样，霍普曼从哈耶克那里接受了这样的观念：竞争是“一个信息、发现与学习的过程”，其结果无法事先确定。
en: Mestmäcker took from Schmitt the need to remain cognizant of the explicitly political nature of the neoliberal project of depoliticizing the economy. His position was supported by another second-generation neoliberal, Erich Hoppmann. Born in 1923, Hoppmann was Mestmäcker’s contemporary who succeeded Hayek in his chair at Freiburg after his retirement. He dismissed as fiction the claim that the economy was simply a machine to be maintained by apolitical minders. Because every form of economic organization presumes some prior decision about outcomes, the “apparent depoliticization of economic policy” only hid disavowed value judgments.

He cited Hayek’s argument that to think of the economy as a machine-like apolitical entity was itself a presupposition about how market society could work. He faulted Eucken for falling into the trap of seeing the “autonomy” of the economy as a realized outcome along with delusions about the possibility of “perfect competition.”
Like Mestmäcker and von der Groeben, Hoppmann took from Hayek the idea that competition was a “process of information, discovery and learning” whose outcome could not be determined beforehand.

zh: 维护竞争，就意味着抵制两种谬误：经济过程在政治上中立的谬误，以及把经济看作一架可以被微调、试调以产出不同结果的机器的谬误。竞争不是一个对象、一种结构，也不是一个终点。它无法被看见。霍普曼说：“不确定性是自由的前提。”
由于“历史过程的开放性”，所能做的，只是把限制性最小的规则写入具有约束力的法律，以促成竞争对人类生活的持续重组。
他援引哈耶克说，我们只剩下两种选择：或者是“目的统治的”（teleocratic）秩序，它会窒碍竞争那普罗米修斯般的品格；或者是“法律统治的”（nomocratic）社会秩序，它把竞争及其一切后果围封在法律秩序之内。
en: Maintaining competition meant resisting the fallacy of the political neutrality of economic processes and of mechanistic visions of the economy as capable of being fine-tuned and tweaked for different outputs. Competition was not an object, a structure, or an endpoint. It could not be seen. “Uncertainty,” Hoppmann put it, “is the prerequisite of freedom.”

“Because of the ‘openness of the historical process,’ ” all that was possible to facilitate the ongoing reorganization of human life effected by competition was to formulate minimally restrictive rules enshrined in binding law.

Citing Hayek, he said that we were left with the choice between a “teleocratic” or purpose-governed order that stymied the promethean character of competition or a “nomocratic” or “law-governed” social order that encased competition with all its consequences.

zh: 宪政主义者从哈耶克那里接受了制度设计的重要性与“竞争作为发现过程”的观念。他们在他的理论中找不到的，是对转折点的注意——新宪法正式确立的那个紧要时刻。同一批思想家从伯姆与施米特那里采纳的，则是对这一时刻如何发生的清醒认识：它经由决断的瞬间来实现。梅斯特马克解决了哈耶克的难题，其办法是把欧洲法院构想为“《欧共体条约》的守护者”
，并把条约本身理解为哈耶克以“宪法所保障的法律原则”约束国家的那一主张。
宪政主义者把欧洲叙述为哈耶克愿景的实现：一个法律统治的社会，它在国家公法之旁守护私法领域不受民主政府的干预。
en: The constitutionalists took from Hayek the importance of institutional design and the idea of competition as a discovery process. What they could not find in his theory was attention to the turning point—the moment of crux where the new constitution was put into place. What those same thinkers adopted from Böhm and Schmitt was a clear sense of how that happened: it was through the moment of decision. Mestmäcker solved Hayek’s problem by conceiving of the European Court of Justice as “the guardian of the EEC Treaty”
and the Treaty itself as Hayek’s call to bind the state through “constitutionally guaranteed legal principles.”

The constitutionalists narrated Europe as a realization of Hayek’s vision of a nomocratic society protecting the division between private law beyond the interference of democratic governments alongside the public law of states.

zh: 因此，只是在1960年代新自由主义宪政主义者的阐发中，欧共体才实现了哈耶克自1930年代以来梦寐以求的双重政府。梅斯特马克尤为关键：他在日内瓦学派第一代新自由主义者的思想与彻底的多层级治理理论之间架起了一座桥梁——这一关联，学界更多是断言而非证成。要紧的是梅斯特马克走得更远。在作为自我实施宪法的《罗马条约》与作为守护者的欧洲法院之中，他开创了一种超国家治理的模式，其内核不仅是一组自由原则，更是一套能够规避民主诉求污染的执法机制。到1972年，梅斯特马克已在提议一次尺度上的转换：《罗马条约》“为逐步约束经济权力提供了基础”，因而可以成为“国际经济法发展的范本，而且不限于欧洲”。
尽管与1960年代实际存在的欧共体相去甚远，新自由主义的欧洲愿景仍像是新自由主义解方的一项关键创新。对欧洲一体化，新自由主义者看到的是一张双面神的面孔。向内看，欧共体示范了如何把一个市场与一套能够跨境实施竞争规则的法律结构结合起来；向外看，欧共体则是一座堡垒，它把殖民地作为联系领土吸纳进一个新的贸易集团，从而“在外围挖出一道壕沟”，破坏了与其他初级产品生产国——尤其是拉丁美洲——长期存在的关系。
两派新自由主义者立场的冲突，正取决于他们是从哪一面观察这片大陆。
en: Thus, only in its elaboration by neoliberal constitutionalists in the 1960s did the EEC offer a realization of the double government dreamed of by Hayek since the 1930s. Mestmäcker, in particular, offered a crucial bridge between the ideas of the first generation of Geneva School neoliberals and thoroughgoing theories of multilevel governance—a link more often asserted than proven by scholars. What is crucial is that Mestmäcker went further. In the Treaty of Rome as self-executing constitution and the European Court of Justice as guardian, he pioneered a model of supranational governance that had not only liberal principles at its core but a mechanism of enforcement capable of evading contamination by democratic claims-making. By 1972 Mestmäcker was suggesting a scale shift: the Rome treaty “provided the foundations for progressively restraining economic power” as “a model for the development of international economic law

Though very far from the actually existing EEC of the 1960s, the neoliberal vision for Europe looked like a crucial innovation of the neoliberal fix. European integration had a Janus face for neoliberals. Looking inward, the EEC was an example of how to integrate a market with a legal structure able to enforce competition across borders. Looking outward, the EEC was a fortress that absorbed colonies as associated territories into a new trading bloc by digging “a moat against the outside,” disrupting long-standing relationships with other primary producing nations, especially in Latin America.
The conflicting stances of the two neoliberal factions reflected the face through which they observed the continent.

zh: 宪政主义者向内审视欧洲，认为它是好的，因为它取得了1930年代新自由主义联邦主义者自己都未曾梦想的执法与监督手段。宪政主义新自由主义者为实现欧共体作出妥协，同时也创造了多层级治理的新形式。梅斯特马克与霍普曼所体现的“哈耶克式的秩序自由主义转化”，指向新自由主义解方的一种新变体。
如果民族国家接受那些约束其相机处置之自由的法律，那么从事贸易这一人权就可以由一个超国家秩序加以执行。多层级经济宪法这一观念，直到二十一世纪仍是日内瓦学派新自由主义的核心。
en: The constitutionalists looked inward and found Europe to be good, having achieved new means of enforcement and oversight that the neoliberal federalists in the 1930s had not dreamed of themselves. Constitutionalist neoliberals made compromises to bring the EEC into existence but also innovated new forms of multitiered governance. The “Hayekian conversion of ordoliberalism” embodied by Mestmäcker and Hoppmann pointed to a novel variation on the neoliberal fix.

If nation-states accepted laws binding their own freedom of discretionary policy, then the human right to trade could be enforceable by a supranational order. The idea of the multilevel economic constitution would be central to Geneva School neoliberalism into the twenty-first century.

zh: 相形之下，普遍主义者从欧洲的外缘观察它，看到的是一个被分割的世界市场。欧非（Eurafrica）妨害了战后走向更自由贸易的进程，令人想起1930年代的特惠贸易协定。日内瓦学派第一代新自由主义者心中，怀着那些在成年之后亲历战间期世界贸易崩溃者的恐惧意识。哈伯勒在1956年警告说：“不要忘了，第一次世界大战后的大萧条，是在停战十一年之后才开始的。”
en: By contrast, the universalists observed Europe from its outer borders and saw a segmented world market. Eurafrica compromised the postwar move toward freer trade and called to mind the preferential trade agreements of the 1930s. The first generation of Geneva School neoliberals had the terrified consciousness of those who had experienced as adults the interwar collapse of world trade. Haberler warned in 1956, “Let us not forget that the Great Depression after World War I did not start until eleven years after the end of hostilities.”

zh: 普遍主义者占着纯粹的优势，却没有执法的机制。哈伯勒有意把他1958年的关贸总协定报告当作反对欧洲日益抬头的保护主义的武器、当作自由秩序的号角。结果却适得其反。当全球南方利用《哈伯勒报告》来要求更大的市场准入时，全球北方既不肯落实自由贸易，也不肯削减补贴。他们转而走上阻力较小的非自由主义道路，在1960年代开始给予发展中国家优惠待遇。这样一来，他们既能继续补贴本国生产，又能给发展中国家的产品更好的市场准入。正如一位学者所言，《罗马条约》中的殖民联系条款“已经冲破了”战后自由规范之墙，而随之而来的优惠浪潮偏离了关贸总协定不歧视的信条。
其结果便是贡纳尔·缪尔达尔（并对此表示赞许）所说的“国际贸易中的双重道德标准”——工业化国家之间相互期待对等，南北之间则实行“特殊与差别待遇”。非殖民化浪潮之后，非洲国家于1963年通过《雅温得协定》重新安排与欧共体的联系——协定在喀麦隆签署，颇具象征意味，反映了新的力量对比；1969年又以《雅温得第二公约》再次更新。
1968年就发展中国家确立普遍优惠制的协议是又一个转折点，因为美国跟随了欧共体首创的不互惠模式。
对新自由主义者来说，成为1960年代模板的，是那个带有历史印记的欧非模式，而不是哈伯勒国联想象中那个无空间的世界。
en: The universalists had the advantage of purity but they lacked the mechanism of enforcement. Haberler intended his 1958 GATT report as a weapon against the growing protectionism of Europe and a clarion call to liberal order. It had the opposite effect. When the Global South used the Haberler Report to demand more market access, the Global North refused to implement free trade and cut subsidies. Instead they took the nonliberal path of less resistance and began granting preferential treatment to developing countries in the 1960s. They could thereby continue to subsidize their own production while also granting better market access to the products of developing nations. The colonial association clauses in the Rome treaty “had breached the wall” of postwar liberal norms, as one scholar put it, and the wave of preferences that followed veered from the GATT credo of nondiscrimination.

The result was what Gunnar Myrdal called (approvingly) a “double standard of morality in international trade”—an expectation of reciprocity between industrialized nations and “special and differential treatment” between North and South. African nations renewed their association with the EEC after the wave of decolonization in the Yaoundé Agreement of 1963, signed symbolically in Cameroon to reflect the new balance of power; they did so again with Yaoundé II in 1969.
The agreement on a Generalized System of Preferences for developing nations in 1968 was another turning point as the United States followed the model of non-reciprocity pioneered by the EEC.
To neoliberals, it was the historically inflected model of Eurafrica, not the spaceless world of Haberler’s League of Nations imaginary, that became the template for the 1960s.

zh: 回望1960年代这个十年，新自由主义者觉得欧非例外已经把精灵放出瓶外。哈伯勒在1964年美国经济学会会长演说中，把欧共体描述为“对全世界一体化的迫在眉睫的危险”。
接勒普克日内瓦教席的杰拉德·柯曾（Gerard Curzon）称，美国允许殖民地留在共同市场之内，是“一桩原罪，日后使美国付出惨重代价”。真如哈伯勒1958年的警告，欧非传递的信息是：“如果关贸总协定的主要缔造者都能以国家理性（
）为由绕过它，那么不难预言，别人很快就会照样去做。”
1964年哈伯勒注意到，拉丁美洲正在追随欧洲的先例，把区域一体化用作“保护主义的手段”。
1970年，柯曾与其搭档兼后来的朝圣山学社社长维多利亚·柯曾-普赖斯（Victoria Curzon-Price）合著撰文，主张以“新自由主义”（neo-liberalism）政策去应对“新保护主义”（neo-protectionism）的流行。
“风正从保护主义那一侧强劲地吹来，政策制定者正在退让，”柯曾夫妇写道，“要扭转这种局面，要么需要坚决的政治抵抗，要么需要一阵反向吹来的强风。”
en: Looking at the decade of the 1960s, neoliberals felt that the Eurafrica exception had let the genie out of the bottle. In his presidential address to the American Economic Association in 1964, Haberler described the EEC as an “imminent danger to worldwide integration.”

The man who took Röpke’s chair in Geneva, Gerard Curzon, called the American decision to allow the colonies in the Common Market “a case of original sin which was to cost the US dearly later on.” True to Haberler’s warning from 1958, the message of Eurafrica had been that “if the GATT could be ignored by its principal author for
it was not difficult to predict that others would soon do likewise.”
In 1964 Haberler noted that Latin America was following the European lead, using regional integration as a “protectionist device.”
Writing in 1970 with his partner (and future MPS president), Victoria Curzon-Price, Curzon advocated a policy of “neo-liberalism” to face the epidemic of “neo-protectionism.”

“The wind is blowing strongly from the protectionist quarter and policy makers are giving way,” the Curzons wrote. “What is needed to reverse this state of affairs is either determined political resistance or a strong wind blowing in the other direction.”

zh: 与来自极左的批评者之间出现了一种值得注意的对称：一些新自由主义者声称，非殖民化之后欧洲与非洲联系的延续，意味着帝国的延续。哈里·约翰逊（Harry Johnson）把欧洲持续实行的贸易优惠称为“新新殖民主义”（neo-neocolonialism）的个案。
另一位新自由主义论者则径直说成“贸易优惠就是帝国主义”。
优惠待遇是联合国贸易与发展会议一类机构成功动员的结果，它们从全球北方那些公然伪善的“自由”国家手里争取到若干贸易让步。新自由主义者完成了一个大胆的空翻：把这种成功谴责为未能彻底非殖民化的失败。世界没有统一的贸易规则，帝国就继续活着。
en: In a notable symmetry with critics from the far left, some neoliberals claimed that the continued links between Europe and Africa after decolonization meant a perpetuation of empire. Harry Johnson designated Europe’s ongoing trade preferences as a case of “neo-neocolonialism.”
Another neoliberal commentator referred to “preferences as imperialism.”

Preferences were a result of the successful mobilization of bodies like the UN Conference on Trade and Development to gain some trade concessions from the openly hypocritical “liberal” nations of the Global North. In a bold somersault, neoliberals condemned this success as a failure to fully decolonize. Without uniform trade rules across the world, empire lived on.

zh: 到1960年代末，在新自由主义者眼中，欧共体“随着自身的前进而越来越公开地违反关贸总协定规则”。
他们如何反应？第7章将表明，他们借鉴了欧洲的制度做法，通过把经济宪法扩展到欧洲本身之外来寻找解方。随着1970年代来自全球南方对自由资本主义统一规则的挑战不断升级，欧洲及其法律成为抗衡建立国际经济新秩序这一诉求的制度样板。普遍主义者与宪政主义者的立场，在1970与1980年代改革关贸总协定的方案中找到了综合。经济宪法的观念，即将走向世界。
en: By the end of the 1960s, neoliberals saw an EEC that “violated GATT rules more and more openly as it advanced.”

How did they react? Chapter 7 shows that they borrowed a page from the European playbook to find a solution by extending the economic constitution beyond Europe itself. As challenges to the uniform rules of liberal capitalism mounted from the Global South in the 1970s, Europe and its laws became a countermodel to the demands for a New International Economic Order. The universalist and constitutionalist position found a synthesis in the plans to reform the GATT of the 1970s and 1980s. The idea of the economic constitution was set to go global.
